caption.en: This slice of kaya toast is one whole. Every fraction starts from one whole.
caption.zh: 这片 kaya 吐司是一个整体。每个分数都从一个整体说起。

caption.en: Three pieces, but not the same size. These pieces are not thirds.
caption.zh: 切成了 3 块，可是大小不一样。这 3 块不是三分之一。

caption.en: Now the toast is cut into 3 equal parts. Only equal parts can be named with a fraction.
caption.zh: 现在吐司被平均分成 3 份。只有平均分出来的部分，才能用分数来说。

caption.en: Equal means the same amount, not always the same shape. Cut corner to corner, this kueh gives two equal halves.
caption.zh: 平均分是说每份一样多，形状不一定相同。这块糕沿对角线切开，两份一样多，都是一半。

caption.en: A prata cut into 4 equal parts: the 4 parts together make the whole prata again.
caption.zh: 一张 prata 平均分成 4 份：4 份合起来，又是整张 prata。

keyFacts.en: A fraction needs one whole cut into equal parts.
keyFacts.zh: 分数要先有一个整体，并且平均分。

keyFacts.en: Equal parts are the same amount; they need not be the same shape.
keyFacts.zh: 平均分指每份一样多，形状不一定一样。

prompt.en: Tap every kueh that is cut into equal parts.
prompt.zh: 点出所有被平均分的千层糕。

guide.en: Equal parts means every part is the same amount. Look at the size of each piece, not at how many pieces there are. Two pieces can be equal even when they are not the same shape.
guide.zh: 平均分，就是每一份一样多。看每一块有多大，不是数有几块。两块形状不同，也可以一样多。

hints.en: Look at one kueh at a time. Are all of its pieces the same size?
hints.zh: 一块一块地看：它的每一份都一样大吗？

hints.en: A square cut corner to corner gives two triangles. Turn one over: does it cover the other exactly?
hints.zh: 正方形沿对角线切开，得到两个三角形。把一个翻过来，能和另一个完全重合吗？

hints.en: Two of the four kueh are cut into equal parts.
hints.zh: 四块千层糕里，有两块是平均分的。

correct.en: Yes. In both of them every piece is the same amount, the two triangles too.
correct.zh: 对。这两块千层糕的每一份都一样多，两个三角形也一样多。

say.en: One kueh you chose has pieces of different sizes, so its parts are not equal. Compare the pieces of each kueh again.
say.zh: 你选的千层糕里，有一块的几份大小不一样，所以不是平均分。再比一比每块千层糕的几份。

say.en: Look again at the kueh cut corner to corner. Same amount of kueh, different shape: the two pieces are still halves.
say.zh: 再看沿对角线切开的那块：两块一样多，只是形状不同，它们仍然是一半。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check each kueh: are all of its pieces the same size?
fallback.zh: 还没对。一块一块检查：每一份都一样大吗？

reveal.en: The kueh cut into four equal strips and the kueh cut corner to corner both have equal parts. The other two have pieces of different sizes.
reveal.zh: 切成四条一样宽的、沿对角线切成两半的，这两块是平均分。另外两块的各份大小不同。

prompt.en: Fold the paper strip to make 4 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把纸条对折，折出 4 个相等的部分。

guide.en: Folding in half makes 2 equal parts, because the two halves lie exactly on top of each other. Fold again and every part is halved again.
guide.zh: 对折一次得到 2 个相等的部分，因为两半正好叠在一起。再折一次，每一份又被平分。

hints.en: Press Fold once. How many parts are there now?
hints.zh: 按一次「对折」。现在有几份？

hints.en: Each fold doubles the number of parts: 1, 2, 4.
hints.zh: 每折一次，份数变成原来的 2 倍：1、2、4。

hints.en: Fold twice.
hints.zh: 对折两次。

correct.en: Yes. Two folds make 4 equal parts. Each part is one quarter of the strip.
correct.zh: 对。对折两次得到 4 个相等的部分，每一份是纸条的四分之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the parts between the creases. You need 4.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数折痕之间有几份，要 4 份。

reveal.en: Fold once for halves, then once more for quarters: 4 equal parts.
reveal.zh: 对折一次得到两半，再折一次得到四份。

prompt.en: Cut the kaya toast into 3 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把这片咖椰吐司切成 3 个相等的部分。

guide.en: Three equal parts need two cuts. The marks under the toast help you measure: every part should cover the same number of marks.
guide.zh: 切成 3 份要切两刀。吐司下面的刻度可以帮你量：每一份占的格数要一样。

hints.en: Tap the toast to place a cut. Tap a cut again to remove it.
hints.zh: 点吐司放一刀；再点这一刀可以去掉。

hints.en: The toast is 12 marks long. How many marks should each part cover?
hints.zh: 吐司长 12 格。每份应该占几格？

hints.en: Cut at mark 4 and at mark 8.
hints.zh: 在第 4 格和第 8 格各切一刀。

correct.en: Yes. Each part is 4 marks long, so the 3 parts are equal: each one is a third.
correct.zh: 对。每份都是 4 格长，3 份一样大，每份是三分之一。

say.en: These parts are not the same size, so they are not thirds. Count the marks in each part and move a cut.
say.zh: 这几份大小不一样，所以不是三分之一。数一数每份占几格，再挪一刀。

fallback.en: Not yet. You need exactly 3 parts, so 2 cuts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。要正好 3 份，也就是切两刀。

reveal.en: Cuts at marks 4 and 8 give three parts of 4 marks each.
reveal.zh: 在第 4 格和第 8 格切，得到三份，每份 4 格。

text.en: A chocolate bar cut into 4 pieces.
text.zh: 一条切成 4 块的巧克力。

text.en: A circle cut into 6 pieces.
text.zh: 一个分成 6 份的圆。

text.en: A paper strip cut into 3 pieces.
text.zh: 一条切成 3 份的纸条。

text.en: A square kueh cut from corner to corner.
text.zh: 一块沿对角线切开的正方形千层糕。

prompt.en: Tap every picture whose whole is cut into equal parts.
prompt.zh: 点出所有把整体平均分的图。

guide.en: Check the amount in each piece of one whole. Equal parts need the same amount, but need not have the same shape. The triangular pieces of the square kueh can be turned to cover each other exactly.
guide.zh: 逐幅看图，比一比同一个整体的各份是不是一样多。平均分的各份不一定形状相同。把千层糕的一个三角形转一转，能和另一个完全重合。

hints.en: Look at the pieces within each picture.
hints.zh: 看每幅图里各份的大小。

hints.en: Compare the widths of the strips and the sizes of the circle pieces and triangles.
hints.zh: 比一比条状各份的宽度、圆里各份和三角形的大小。

hints.en: Choose the circle and the kueh cut corner to corner.
hints.zh: 选圆和沿对角线切开的千层糕。

correct.en: Yes. Each circle piece has the same amount, and the two kueh triangles also have the same amount.
correct.zh: 对。圆里的各份一样多，千层糕的两个三角形也一样多。

say.en: The chocolate or paper strip you chose has pieces of different widths. Compare every piece within that whole.
say.zh: 你选的巧克力或纸条里，各份宽度不同。再比一比这个整体里的每一份。

say.en: You left out the triangular pieces of kueh. Turn one triangle to cover the other: both have the same amount, so they are equal halves.
say.zh: 你漏选了切成三角形的千层糕。把一个三角形转一转，能和另一个完全重合，所以两份各是一半。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check all four pictures and compare the amount in every piece of each whole.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查四幅图，比一比每个整体的各份是不是一样多。

reveal.en: Choose B and D. The circle has six equal pieces, and the diagonal divides the square kueh into two equal halves. A and C have pieces of different widths.
reveal.zh: 选 B 和 D。圆被平均分成六份，千层糕沿对角线分成相等的两半。A 和 C 的各份宽度不同。

prompt.en: Fold the paper strip to make 2 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把纸条对折，折出 2 个相等的部分。

guide.en: Bring the two ends of the strip together. When the halves lie exactly on top of each other, you have two equal parts.
guide.zh: 把纸条的两端对齐。两半正好叠在一起，说明这两份一样多。

hints.en: Look at the whole strip before folding.
hints.zh: 先看这条完整的纸条。

hints.en: Folding in half changes one whole into two equal parts.
hints.zh: 对折一次，把整体分成相等的两份。

hints.en: Press Fold once, then count the parts.
hints.zh: 按一次「对折」，再数一数有几份。

correct.en: Yes. One fold makes 2 equal parts because the two halves cover each other exactly.
correct.zh: 对。对折一次得到 2 个相等的部分，两半能完全重合。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the parts between the creases; you need 2 equal parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数折痕之间有几份，要 2 个相等的部分。

reveal.en: Fold once. The crease divides the strip into two equal halves.
reveal.zh: 对折一次。折痕把纸条平均分成两半。

prompt.en: Fold the paper strip to make 8 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把纸条对折，折出 8 个相等的部分。

guide.en: Each fold in half divides every part into two equal parts. Count the parts after each fold and stop when you have eight.
guide.zh: 每对折一次，每一份又被平均分成两份。每折一次就数一数，得到八份时停下来。

hints.en: Look at the spaces between the creases after each fold.
hints.zh: 每折一次，看看折痕之间有几份。

hints.en: The number of equal parts doubles: 1, 2, 4, 8.
hints.zh: 相等的份数每次变成原来的 2 倍：1、2、4、8。

hints.en: Fold three times in all.
hints.zh: 一共对折三次。

correct.en: Yes. Three folds make 8 equal parts because every fold halves each part again.
correct.zh: 对。对折三次得到 8 个相等的部分，因为每次都把每份再平分。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the equal parts between the creases; stop at 8.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数折痕之间相等的部分，得到 8 份时停下来。

reveal.en: Fold once to make 2 parts, again to make 4, and once more to make 8 equal parts.
reveal.zh: 对折一次得到 2 份，再折一次得到 4 份，再折一次得到 8 个相等的部分。

prompt.en: Cut the chocolate bar into 2 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把这条巧克力平均分成 2 份。

guide.en: One cut makes two pieces. Use the grid under the bar to check that both pieces have the same length.
guide.zh: 切一刀得到两块。用巧克力下面的刻度量一量，两块要一样长。

hints.en: Look at the lengths on both sides of your cut.
hints.zh: 看看切线两边各有多长。

hints.en: Share the 12 grid spaces equally between two parts.
hints.zh: 把 12 格平均分成两份。

hints.en: Place one cut at mark 6, counting from the left end.
hints.zh: 从左端数，在第 6 格的末端切一刀。

correct.en: Yes. Both pieces are 6 grid spaces long, so each is half of the chocolate bar.
correct.zh: 对。两块都是 6 格长，所以每块都是巧克力的一半。

say.en: The two pieces have different lengths. Count the grid spaces on each side and move the cut so both lengths match.
say.zh: 两块的长度不同。数一数切线两边各占几格，再挪切线，让两边一样长。

fallback.en: Not yet. You need one cut to make two pieces; check that it is halfway along the bar.
fallback.zh: 还没对。切一刀得到两块，看看切线是不是在巧克力的中间。

reveal.en: Cut at mark 6. The two lengths are 6 and 6 grid spaces, so the parts are equal.
reveal.zh: 在第 6 格的末端切一刀，两块各占 6 格，就是平均分。

prompt.en: Cut the ribbon into 4 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把这条丝带平均分成 4 份。

guide.en: Four equal pieces need three cuts. Include both end pieces when you compare the lengths along the 12-space grid.
guide.zh: 切成四份要切三刀。用下面的 12 格刻度比较各份长度，两端的份也要算进去。

hints.en: Look at every piece, including the two at the ends.
hints.zh: 看看每一份，也别漏掉两端的份。

hints.en: Divide 12 grid spaces equally among four pieces.
hints.zh: 把 12 格平均分给四份。

hints.en: Cut at marks 3, 6 and 9, counting from the left end.
hints.zh: 从左端数，在第 3、6、9 格的末端各切一刀。

correct.en: Yes. All four pieces are 3 grid spaces long, so each is a quarter of the ribbon.
correct.zh: 对。四份都是 3 格长，每份是丝带的四分之一。

say.en: You have four pieces, but their lengths differ. Count the spaces in the end pieces as well as the middle pieces.
say.zh: 你切成了四份，但各份长短不同。两端和中间的每份都要数一数占几格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check that you have three cuts and that all four pieces have the same length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。检查是不是切了三刀，四份是不是一样长。

reveal.en: Cuts at marks 3, 6 and 9 divide the 12-space ribbon into four pieces of 3 spaces each.
reveal.zh: 在第 3、6、9 格的末端切，把 12 格长的丝带分成四份，每份 3 格。

prompt.en: Cut the paper strip into 6 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把这条纸条平均分成 6 份。

guide.en: The whole strip is 12 grid spaces long. Six equal pieces must each cover the same number of spaces, including the pieces at both ends.
guide.zh: 整条纸条长 12 格。分成相等的六份，每份占的格数要一样，两端的份也一样。

hints.en: Look at the grid spaces between cuts and at both ends.
hints.zh: 看看切线之间和两端各占几格。

hints.en: Share 12 grid spaces equally among six pieces.
hints.zh: 把 12 格平均分给六份。

hints.en: Place five cuts at marks 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10.
hints.zh: 在第 2、4、6、8、10 格的末端各切一刀。

correct.en: Yes. Every piece covers 2 grid spaces, so the strip has 6 equal parts.
correct.zh: 对。每份都占 2 格，所以纸条被平均分成 6 份。

say.en: There are six pieces, but some cover more spaces than others. Compare their lengths and leave 2 spaces in every piece.
say.zh: 虽然有六份，但有的占格多，有的占格少。比一比各份长度，让每份都占 2 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count five cuts to make six pieces, then compare all six lengths.
fallback.zh: 还没对。切五刀得到六份，再比一比六份的长度。

reveal.en: Cut at marks 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10. Each of the six pieces is 2 grid spaces long.
reveal.zh: 在第 2、4、6、8、10 格的末端切，得到六份，每份 2 格长。

prompt.en: Cut the toast into 8 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 把这片吐司平均分成 8 份。

guide.en: This grid divides the whole toast into 24 spaces. Use the spaces to measure eight pieces of equal width.
guide.zh: 这片吐司下面的刻度把整体分成 24 格。用这些格子量一量，切成八份，每份一样宽。

hints.en: Look at the spaces between the marks under the toast.
hints.zh: 看看吐司下面刻度之间的格子。

hints.en: Share 24 grid spaces equally among eight pieces.
hints.zh: 把 24 格平均分给八份。

hints.en: Cut every 3 spaces: at marks 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 21.

correct.en: Yes. Each piece is 3 grid spaces wide, so the toast is cut into 8 equal parts.
correct.zh: 对。每份都是 3 格宽，所以吐司被平均分成 8 份。

say.en: You made eight pieces, but their widths differ. Count the spaces in each piece and move the cuts so every piece covers 3 spaces.
say.zh: 你切成了八份，但各份宽度不同。数一数每份占几格，再挪切线，让每份都占 3 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. You need seven cuts for eight pieces; compare their widths using the grid.
fallback.zh: 还没对。切七刀得到八份，再用刻度比一比各份的宽度。

reveal.en: Cut at marks 3, 6, 9, 12, 15, 18 and 21. The 24-space whole becomes eight pieces of 3 spaces each.
reveal.zh: 在第 3、6、9、12、15、18、21 格的末端切，把 24 格平均分成八份，每份 3 格。

caption.en: A prata cut into 4 equal parts. One of the parts is one quarter, written {1/4}.
caption.zh: 一张 prata 平均分成 4 份，其中 1 份是四分之一，写作 {1/4}。

caption.en: The bottom number, the denominator, counts all the equal parts in the whole: 4. The top number, the numerator, counts the parts taken: 1.
caption.zh: 下面的数是分母，数的是整体平均分成了几份：4。上面的数是分子，数的是取了几份：1。

caption.en: The same idea on a strip cut into 6 equal parts: one part is {1/6}.
caption.zh: 换成平均分成 6 份的纸条，道理一样：其中 1 份是 {1/6}。

caption.en: Cut the same strip into 8 equal parts and one part is {1/8}. More parts in the same whole make each part smaller.
caption.zh: 同一张纸条平均分成 8 份，1 份是 {1/8}。同一个整体分的份数越多，每一份就越小。

keyFacts.en: One of 4 equal parts is {1/4}; one of 6 equal parts is {1/6}.
keyFacts.zh: 4 等份中的 1 份是 {1/4}；6 等份中的 1 份是 {1/6}。

keyFacts.en: Denominator: equal parts in the whole. Numerator: parts taken.
keyFacts.zh: 分母：整体平均分成几份。分子：取了几份。

keyFacts.en: More parts in the same whole, smaller parts.
keyFacts.zh: 同一个整体分得越多，每份越小。

prompt.en: Shade one of the 4 equal parts of the prata.
prompt.zh: 把 prata 的 4 个相等部分涂上一份。

guide.en: The prata is one whole cut into 4 equal parts. One of those parts is one quarter, written {1/4}. The bottom number counts the equal parts; the top number counts the parts you take.
guide.zh: 这张 prata 是一个整体，平均分成 4 份。其中一份是四分之一，写作 {1/4}。下面的数是整体平均分的份数，上面的数是取了几份。

hints.en: The prata has 4 equal parts. You need one of them.
hints.zh: 这张 prata 平均分成 4 份，要涂其中一份。

hints.en: Tap any one part, and only one.
hints.zh: 点任意一份，只点一份。

correct.en: Yes. One of 4 equal parts is {1/4}, one quarter.
correct.zh: 对。4 个相等部分中的一份是 {1/4}，四分之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Shade just one part.
fallback.zh: 还没对。只涂一份。

reveal.en: One part out of the 4 is shaded: {1/4}.

prompt.en: What fraction of the bar is shaded?
prompt.zh: 涂色部分是整条的几分之几？

guide.en: First count all the equal parts in the whole: that is the bottom number, the denominator. Then count the shaded parts: that is the top number, the numerator.
guide.zh: 先数整体一共平均分成几份，这是下面的数，叫分母；再数涂色的有几份，这是上面的数，叫分子。

hints.en: How many equal parts are in the whole bar?
hints.zh: 整条一共有几个相等的部分？

hints.en: The bottom number counts all the parts, shaded and not shaded.
hints.zh: 分母要数所有的份，涂了的和没涂的都算。

hints.en: 6 equal parts, 1 shaded.
hints.zh: 一共 6 份，涂了 1 份。

correct.en: Yes. 1 of 6 equal parts is shaded, so it is {1/6}, one sixth.
correct.zh: 对。6 个相等部分中涂了 1 份，是 {1/6}，六分之一。

say.en: The bottom number counts all the equal parts in the whole, shaded and not shaded. Count them all again.
say.zh: 分母要数整体里所有相等的部分，涂了的和没涂的都算。再数一遍。

say.en: The top number counts the parts you have; the bottom number counts the parts in the whole. Swap them round.
say.zh: 分子数的是取了几份，分母数的是整体一共几份。把两个数换一换位置。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the parts first, then the shaded ones.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数总份数，再数涂色的份数。

reveal.en: The whole has 6 equal parts and 1 is shaded: {1/6}.
reveal.zh: 整体平均分成 6 份，涂了 1 份：{1/6}。

prompt.en: Which picture shows {1/3}?
prompt.zh: 哪幅图表示 {1/3}？

guide.en: {1/3} means one of 3 equal parts. Check two things in each picture: are there 3 parts in the whole, and are they the same size?
guide.zh: {1/3} 表示平均分成 3 份中的 1 份。每幅图都检查两件事：整体是不是分成 3 份？这 3 份是不是一样大？

hints.en: Count all the parts in each picture, shaded and not shaded.
hints.zh: 数一数每幅图一共有几份，涂了的和没涂的都算。

hints.en: Then check that the parts are the same size.
hints.zh: 再看这几份是不是一样大。

correct.en: Yes. That whole has 3 equal parts and 1 is shaded: {1/3}.
correct.zh: 对。这个整体平均分成 3 份，涂了 1 份：{1/3}。

say.en: That picture has 3 parts, but they are not the same size, so they are not thirds.
say.zh: 那幅图有 3 份，但大小不一样，所以不是三分之一。

say.en: That picture has 1 part shaded and 3 not shaded: 4 parts in all. That is {1/4}, not {1/3}.
say.zh: 那幅图涂了 1 份，没涂 3 份，一共 4 份。这是 {1/4}，不是 {1/3}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for 3 equal parts with 1 shaded.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找平均分成 3 份、涂了 1 份的那幅图。

reveal.en: Picture A has 3 equal parts with 1 shaded: {1/3}.
reveal.zh: 图 A 平均分成 3 份，涂了 1 份：{1/3}。

prompt.en: Shade one of the 3 equal parts of the ribbon.
prompt.zh: 在丝带的 3 个相等部分中涂一份。

guide.en: The whole ribbon has 3 equal parts. To show {1/3}, you take just one part. The denominator counts all 3 parts; the numerator counts the one you shade.
guide.zh: 整条丝带平均分成 3 份。表示 {1/3}，只要取其中一份。分母数整体的 3 份，分子数涂了的 1 份。

hints.en: Look at all the equal parts of the ribbon.
hints.zh: 先看整条丝带的相等部分。

hints.en: The 1 in {1/3} tells you how many parts to shade.
hints.zh: {1/3} 的分子 1 告诉你要涂几份。

hints.en: Tap any one part and leave the other two unshaded.
hints.zh: 点任意一份，另外两份不涂。

correct.en: Yes. You shaded 1 of the ribbon's 3 equal parts, so it shows {1/3}.
correct.zh: 对。丝带平均分成 3 份，你涂了 1 份，表示 {1/3}。

say.en: You left one part unshaded and shaded two. The numerator 1 counts the part you take, so look at the shaded parts and keep just one.
say.zh: 你留了 1 份没涂，涂了 2 份。分子 1 数的是取的份数，请看涂色部分，只保留一份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shaded parts: you need just one of the 3 equal parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看涂色部分：3 份中只要涂一份。

reveal.en: Shade any one part. There are 3 equal parts in the whole and 1 shaded: {1/3}.
reveal.zh: 涂任意一份。整体平均分成 3 份，涂了 1 份：{1/3}。

prompt.en: Shade {1/8} of the circle.
prompt.zh: 涂出圆的 {1/8}。

guide.en: Count the equal parts in the whole circle: there are 8. One of them is {1/8}. You shade one part because the numerator is 1.
guide.zh: 数一数，整个圆平均分成 8 份。其中一份是 {1/8}。分子是 1，所以你只涂一份。

hints.en: Look around the whole circle and count its equal parts.
hints.zh: 看整个圆，数一数相等的部分。

hints.en: The denominator 8 counts all the parts; the numerator 1 counts the shaded parts.
hints.zh: 分母 8 数总份数，分子 1 数涂色的份数。

hints.en: Shade one part and leave the other seven unshaded.
hints.zh: 涂一份，另外七份不涂。

correct.en: Yes. One of the circle's 8 equal parts is shaded, so it shows {1/8}.
correct.zh: 对。圆的 8 个相等部分中涂了 1 份，表示 {1/8}。

say.en: You left one part unshaded and shaded seven. The 1 counts shaded parts, so look at your shading and keep only one part shaded.
say.zh: 你留了 1 份没涂，涂了 7 份。分子 1 数的是涂色的份数，请只保留一份涂色。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the shaded parts: {1/8} needs only one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数涂色的份数：{1/8} 只要涂一份。

reveal.en: Any one of the 8 equal parts shows {1/8}; the other seven stay unshaded.
reveal.zh: 8 个相等部分中，任意一份都表示 {1/8}，另外七份不涂。

prompt.en: What fraction of the cake is shaded?
prompt.zh: 涂色部分是整个蛋糕的几分之几？

guide.en: First count all the cake's equal parts, including the shaded one, for the denominator. Then count the shaded parts for the numerator. Write the numerator above the denominator.
guide.zh: 先数整个蛋糕的相等部分，涂了的也算，这是分母。再数涂色的份数，这是分子。分子写在分母上面。

hints.en: Look at the whole cake, not just the unshaded pieces.
hints.zh: 看整个蛋糕，不只看没涂的部分。

hints.en: Count all equal parts for the bottom number and shaded parts for the top number.
hints.zh: 总份数写在下面，涂色的份数写在上面。

hints.en: There are 5 equal parts in all, with 1 shaded.
hints.zh: 一共 5 份，涂了 1 份。

correct.en: Yes. The cake has 5 equal parts and 1 is shaded, so the fraction is {1/5}.
correct.zh: 对。蛋糕平均分成 5 份，涂了 1 份，所以是 {1/5}。

say.en: 4 counts only the unshaded parts. Look at the whole cake and include the shaded part: the denominator is 5.
say.zh: 分母写成 4，是只数了没涂的份。看整个蛋糕，把涂了的一份也算上，分母是 5。

say.en: You put the total on top. Look at the shaded part: 1 goes on top, and all 5 equal parts go on the bottom.
say.zh: 你把总份数写在上面了。看涂色部分：1 写在上面，总份数 5 写在下面。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the equal parts for the denominator, then the shaded part for the numerator.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数总份数作分母，再数涂色的份数作分子。

reveal.en: Write {1/5}: 1 shaded part above, 5 equal parts in the whole below.
reveal.zh: 写 {1/5}：涂了 1 份，1 写在上面；整体有 5 份，5 写在下面。

prompt.en: Write the fraction shown by the shaded part of the strip.
prompt.zh: 写出纸条涂色部分表示的分数。

guide.en: The shaded part can be anywhere in the strip. Count every equal part for the denominator and only the shaded parts for the numerator. One shaded part means the numerator is 1.
guide.zh: 涂色部分在纸条的哪个位置都可以。数所有相等的部分作分母，数涂色的份数作分子。涂了 1 份，分子就是 1。

hints.en: Look from one end of the strip to the other and count every part.
hints.zh: 从纸条的一端数到另一端，每一份都算。

hints.en: Include the shaded part in the total for the bottom number.
hints.zh: 下面的总份数也要包括涂色的那一份。

hints.en: 9 equal parts in the whole, 1 shaded.
hints.zh: 整体有 9 个相等部分，涂了 1 份。

correct.en: Yes. One of the strip's 9 equal parts is shaded, so it shows {1/9}.
correct.zh: 对。纸条的 9 个相等部分中涂了 1 份，表示 {1/9}。

say.en: 8 counts the unshaded parts only. Look along the whole strip and count the shaded part too: there are 9 parts.
say.zh: 分母写成 8，是只数了没涂的份。看整条纸条，把涂了的一份也算上，一共 9 份。

say.en: 9 is the total number of equal parts, so it belongs below. Look at the shading: just 1 part is taken, so 1 belongs above.
say.zh: 9 是整体的总份数，要写在下面。看涂色部分：只取了 1 份，1 要写在上面。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the total number of equal parts and the number shaded.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看整体的总份数和涂色的份数。

reveal.en: The denominator is 9 and the numerator is 1: {1/9}.
reveal.zh: 整体平均分成 9 份，涂了 1 份，分母是 9，分子是 1：{1/9}。

prompt.en: What fraction of the chocolate bar is shaded?
prompt.zh: 涂色部分是整条巧克力的几分之几？

guide.en: Count the equal parts across the whole chocolate bar. That total is the denominator, below the fraction line. Count the shaded parts for the numerator, above the line.
guide.zh: 数整条巧克力的相等部分。总份数是分母，写在分数线下面。涂色的份数是分子，写在上面。

hints.en: Look at every piece, shaded and unshaded.
hints.zh: 看每一份，涂了的和没涂的都算。

hints.en: Put the total below the line and the shaded count above it.
hints.zh: 总份数写在线下面，涂色的份数写在上面。

hints.en: There are 12 equal parts and only 1 is shaded.
hints.zh: 一共 12 个相等部分，只涂了 1 份。

correct.en: Yes. 1 of the chocolate bar's 12 equal parts is shaded, so it is {1/12}.
correct.zh: 对。巧克力条的 12 个相等部分中涂了 1 份，所以是 {1/12}。

say.en: 11 counts just the unshaded pieces. Look at the whole bar and include the shaded piece too: the denominator is 12.
say.zh: 分母写成 11，是只数了没涂的份。看整条巧克力，把涂了的一份也算上，分母是 12。

say.en: The total 12 belongs below the fraction line. Look at the one shaded piece: its count, 1, belongs above the line.
say.zh: 总份数 12 要写在分数线下面。看涂色的一份：涂色份数 1 要写在上面。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the whole bar's equal parts first, then the shaded pieces.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数整条的相等部分，再数涂色的份数。

reveal.en: Write {1/12}: 12 equal parts in the whole and 1 shaded part.
reveal.zh: 整体平均分成 12 份，涂了 1 份，所以写 {1/12}。

prompt.en: Which picture shows {1/5}?
prompt.zh: 哪幅图表示 {1/5}？

guide.en: For {1/5}, you need one shaded part out of 5 equal parts in the whole. Count every part in each picture. Then check that the parts are the same size.
guide.zh: {1/5} 要把整体平均分成 5 份，涂其中 1 份。数每幅图的总份数。再检查各份是不是一样大。

hints.en: Look at all the parts in each picture, including the shaded one.
hints.zh: 看每幅图的所有部分，涂色的也算。

hints.en: Five parts must be equal in size to be fifths.
hints.zh: 5 份要一样大，每份才是五分之一。

hints.en: Look for 5 equal parts with just 1 shaded.
hints.zh: 找平均分成 5 份、只涂 1 份的图。

correct.en: Yes. Picture B has 5 equal parts with 1 shaded, so it shows {1/5}.
correct.zh: 对。图 B 平均分成 5 份，涂了 1 份，表示 {1/5}。

say.en: Picture A has 5 parts of different sizes. Compare their widths: fifths need 5 equal parts.
say.zh: 图 A 有 5 份，但大小不同。比一比各份的宽度：五分之一要把整体平均分成 5 份。

say.en: Picture C has 5 unshaded parts and 1 shaded part. Count them all: 6 equal parts show {1/6}.
say.zh: 图 C 有 5 份没涂、1 份涂了。全部数一数，一共 6 个相等部分，表示 {1/6}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for one shaded part in a whole with 5 equal parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找整体平均分成 5 份、涂了 1 份的图。

reveal.en: Choose picture B: the circle is divided into 5 equal parts and 1 is shaded, showing {1/5}.
reveal.zh: 选图 B：圆平均分成 5 份，涂了 1 份，表示 {1/5}。

prompt.en: Which fraction names the shaded part of the circle?
prompt.zh: 哪个分数表示圆的涂色部分？

guide.en: Count all the circle's equal parts for the denominator. Include the shaded part in that count. The numerator counts the one part shaded.
guide.zh: 数整个圆的相等部分作分母。涂色的一份也要算在总份数里。分子数涂色的那一份。

hints.en: Look around the whole circle and count every part.
hints.zh: 看整个圆，每一份都数进去。

hints.en: Six parts are unshaded, but the denominator counts the shaded part too.
hints.zh: 有六份没涂，但分母也要算涂色的那一份。

hints.en: Choose the fraction with 7 below and 1 above.
hints.zh: 选下面是 7、上面是 1 的分数。

correct.en: Yes. The whole has 7 equal parts and 1 is shaded, so the fraction is {1/7}.
correct.zh: 对。整体平均分成 7 份，涂了 1 份，所以是 {1/7}。

say.en: 6 counts only the unshaded parts. Look around the whole circle and include the shaded part: there are 7 equal parts.
say.zh: 分母写成 6，是只数了没涂的份。看整个圆，把涂色的一份也算进去，一共 7 个相等部分。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the total number of equal parts, including the shaded one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看相等部分的总份数，涂色的也算。

reveal.en: Choose {1/7}: the denominator 7 counts all equal parts and the numerator 1 counts the shaded part.
reveal.zh: 选 {1/7}：分母 7 数所有相等的部分，分子 1 数涂色的一份。

caption.en: A chocolate bar cut into 8 equal parts. One part is {1/8}.
caption.zh: 一条巧克力平均分成 8 份，1 份是 {1/8}。

caption.en: Take 3 of those parts: three one-eighths make three eighths.
caption.zh: 取其中 3 份：3 个八分之一就是八分之三。

caption.en: On a cake cut into 6 equal parts, 5 parts are {5/6}. The numerator 5 counts the parts taken, the denominator 6 counts all the parts.
caption.zh: 一个蛋糕平均分成 6 块，5 块就是 {5/6}。分子 5 数取的块数，分母 6 数一共几块。

caption.en: When every part is taken, the fraction is the whole: 4 quarters make 1.
caption.zh: 所有的份都取了，就是整个：4 个四分之一合起来是 1。

keyFacts.en: {3/8} is 3 parts of {1/8}.
When the numerator equals the denominator, the fraction is 1 whole.
keyFacts.zh: 分子等于分母，分数就是 1 个整体。

prompt.en: Shade {3/8} of the chocolate bar.
prompt.zh: 把巧克力条涂出 {3/8}。

guide.en: {3/8} is 3 parts out of 8 equal parts. Each part is {1/8}, so {3/8} is three of them: {1/8} + {1/8} + {1/8}.

hints.en: The bar already has 8 equal parts.
hints.zh: 巧克力条已经平均分成 8 份了。

hints.en: The top number tells you how many parts to shade.
hints.zh: 分子告诉你要涂几份。

hints.en: Shade 3 parts.
hints.zh: 涂 3 份。

correct.en: Yes. 3 of the 8 equal parts are shaded: {3/8}.

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the shaded parts. You need 3 of the 8.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数涂了几份，要 8 份中的 3 份。

reveal.en: Three eighths: 3 of the 8 parts shaded.
reveal.zh: 八分之三：8 份中涂 3 份。

prompt.en: What fraction of the prata is shaded?
prompt.zh: 涂色部分是这张 prata 的几分之几？

guide.en: Count the equal parts of the whole prata first, then the shaded parts. The parts in the whole go at the bottom.
guide.zh: 先数整张 prata 平均分成几份，再数涂色的有几份。整体的份数写在下面。

hints.en: How many equal parts does the whole prata have?
hints.zh: 整张 prata 平均分成了几份？

hints.en: 6 equal parts. How many are shaded?
hints.zh: 一共 6 份。涂了几份？

correct.en: Yes. 5 of the 6 equal parts are shaded: {5/6}.

say.en: 5 parts are shaded and 1 is not. The bottom number counts all 6 parts in the whole.
say.zh: 涂了 5 份，没涂 1 份。分母要数整体的全部 6 份。

say.en: The top number counts the shaded parts; the bottom number counts all the parts in the whole.
say.zh: 分子数涂了几份，分母数整体一共几份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all 6 parts for the bottom number, then the shaded parts for the top.
fallback.zh: 还没对。分母数全部的份数，分子数涂了的份数。

reveal.en: 6 equal parts, 5 shaded: {5/6}.
reveal.zh: 平均分成 6 份，涂了 5 份：{5/6}。

prompt.en: Shade all 4 parts. Then write how many wholes {4/4} is.
prompt.zh: 把 4 份都涂上，再写出 {4/4} 是几个整体。

guide.en: When every equal part is shaded, you have the whole thing. The top and bottom numbers are the same, so the fraction is 1 whole.
guide.zh: 所有相等的部分都涂上，就是整个整体。分子和分母一样，这个分数就等于 1 个整体。

hints.en: Shade every part of the strip.
hints.zh: 把纸条的每一份都涂上。

hints.en: 4 quarters make the whole strip.
hints.zh: 4 个四分之一合起来就是整条纸条。

correct.en: Yes. {4/4} is all 4 quarters, the whole strip: 1 whole.
correct.zh: 对。{4/4} 是全部 4 个四分之一，也就是整条纸条：1 个整体。

fallback.en: Not yet. Shade every part, then count the whole strips.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把每一份都涂上，再数有几个整条。

reveal.en: All 4 quarters shaded: {4/4} = 1.
reveal.zh: 4 个四分之一都涂上：{4/4} = 1。

prompt.en: Shade {2/7} of the circle.
prompt.zh: 把圆涂出 {2/7}。

guide.en: The circle has 7 equal parts, each {1/7} of the whole. You need two of these parts to show {2/7}.
guide.zh: 圆平均分成 7 份，每份是整体的 {1/7}。取这样的 2 份，就是 {2/7}。

hints.en: Look at all 7 equal parts of the circle.
hints.zh: 看看圆的全部 7 个相等部分。

hints.en: The top number counts the parts you shade.
hints.zh: 分子数你涂了几份。

hints.en: Shade 2 of the 7 parts.
hints.zh: 涂出 7 份中的 2 份。

correct.en: Yes. Two parts, each {1/7}, make {2/7} of the circle.
correct.zh: 对。每份是 {1/7}，涂 2 份就是圆的 {2/7}。

say.en: You shaded the 5 parts that should be left unshaded. Look at the top number: shade 2 parts.
say.zh: 你涂了应当留白的 5 份。看分子：要涂 2 份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count your shaded parts; you need 2 out of all 7 parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数涂了几份，要涂全部 7 份中的 2 份。

reveal.en: Shade 2 equal parts. Each is {1/7}, so together they are {2/7}.
reveal.zh: 涂 2 个相等的部分。每份是 {1/7}，合起来是 {2/7}。

prompt.en: Shade {5/12} of the ribbon.
prompt.zh: 把丝带涂出 {5/12}。

guide.en: The whole ribbon has 12 equal parts. Each part is {1/12}, so {5/12} means five of those parts.
guide.zh: 整条丝带平均分成 12 份。每份是 {1/12}，{5/12} 就是这样的 5 份。

hints.en: Count the equal parts along the whole ribbon.
hints.zh: 数一数整条丝带的相等部分。

hints.en: Keep all 12 parts as the whole; the top number tells you how many to shade.
hints.zh: 全部 12 份是整体；分子告诉你涂几份。

hints.en: Shade 5 parts and leave 7 unshaded.
hints.zh: 涂 5 份，留下 7 份不涂。

correct.en: Yes. Five of the 12 equal parts are shaded, so you have {5/12}.
correct.zh: 对。12 个相等部分中涂了 5 份，就是 {5/12}。

say.en: You shaded the 7 parts that should be left unshaded. Look at the numerator 5 and count your shaded parts again.
say.zh: 你涂了应当留白的 7 份。看分子 5，再数一数涂了几份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the top number and count how many of the 12 parts you shaded.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看分子，再数 12 份中你涂了几份。

reveal.en: Shade 5 of the 12 equal parts: five parts, each {1/12}, make {5/12}.
reveal.zh: 涂出 12 份中的 5 份：每份是 {1/12}，5 份合起来是 {5/12}。

prompt.en: What fraction of the strip is shaded?
prompt.zh: 涂色部分是纸条的几分之几？

guide.en: Count all the equal parts of the strip for the bottom number. Count the shaded parts for the top number, even when they are apart.
guide.zh: 分母数整条纸条的全部相等部分。分子数涂色的份数，涂色部分分开也照样数。

hints.en: Look along the whole strip, including the unshaded parts.
hints.zh: 看整条纸条，也要数没涂色的部分。

hints.en: There are 9 equal parts in all. Count only the shaded parts next.
hints.zh: 一共 9 个相等的部分。接着只数涂色的份数。

hints.en: Write 4 on top and 9 at the bottom.
hints.zh: 分子写 4，分母写 9。

correct.en: Yes. There are 9 equal parts and 4 are shaded: four ninths, {4/9}.
correct.zh: 对。整体有 9 个相等部分，涂了 4 份：{4/9}。

say.en: 5 counts only the unshaded parts. For the bottom number, count all 9 parts of the strip.
say.zh: 分母写成 5，是只数了没涂色的份数。分母要数纸条的全部 9 份。

say.en: The two counts have changed places. Put the 4 shaded parts on top and all 9 parts at the bottom.
say.zh: 两个数的位置反了。涂色的 4 份写在分子，全部 9 份写在分母。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the parts for the bottom number, then the shaded parts for the top.
fallback.zh: 还没对。分母数全部份数，分子数涂色份数。

reveal.en: Each part is {1/9}. Four shaded parts make {4/9}, wherever they are on the strip.
reveal.zh: 每份是 {1/9}。涂色的 4 份合起来是 {4/9}，不论它们在纸条的哪里。

prompt.en: What fraction of the circle is shaded?
prompt.zh: 涂色部分是圆的几分之几？

guide.en: The bottom number counts every equal part in the whole circle. The top number counts just the shaded parts.
guide.zh: 分母数整个圆的全部相等部分。分子只数涂色的份数。

hints.en: Count every equal part around the circle.
hints.zh: 沿着圆数一数全部相等部分。

hints.en: Use all 8 parts for the bottom number, not just the unshaded parts.
hints.zh: 分母用全部 8 份，不是只数没涂色的部分。

hints.en: 3 parts are shaded out of 8 equal parts.
hints.zh: 8 个相等部分中，涂了 3 份。

correct.en: Yes. Each part is {1/8}, and 3 of them are shaded, so the fraction is {3/8}.
correct.zh: 对。每份是 {1/8}，涂了这样的 3 份，所以是 {3/8}。

say.en: 5 is the number of unshaded parts. Look at the whole circle: its 8 equal parts go at the bottom.
say.zh: 5 是没涂色的份数。看整个圆：全部 8 份才是分母。

say.en: 8 counts all the parts, so it belongs at the bottom. Look at the 3 shaded parts for the top number.
say.zh: 8 数的是全部份数，要写在分母。看涂色的 3 份，分子写 3。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the whole circle for the bottom number and the shaded parts for the top.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看整个圆来确定分母，看涂色份数来确定分子。

reveal.en: The whole has 8 equal parts and 3 are shaded. Write {3/8}: three one-eighths.
reveal.zh: 整个圆有 8 个相等部分，涂了 3 份。写成 {3/8}，就是 3 个 {1/8}。

prompt.en: What fraction of the strip is shaded?
prompt.zh: 涂色部分是纸条的几分之几？

guide.en: Count shaded and unshaded parts together to find the bottom number. Each part is one tenth of the strip; count the shaded tenths for the top number.
guide.zh: 涂色和没涂色的份数合起来，才是分母。每份是纸条的十分之一，数涂了几个十分之一来确定分子。

hints.en: Look at the whole strip, including the 3 unshaded parts.
hints.zh: 看整条纸条，也包括没涂色的 3 份。

hints.en: There are 10 equal parts in the whole. How many are shaded?
hints.zh: 整体一共 10 个相等部分。涂了几份？

hints.en: 7 of the 10 parts are shaded.
hints.zh: 10 份中涂了 7 份。

correct.en: Yes. Seven shaded tenths make {7/10} of the strip.
correct.zh: 对。涂了 7 个十分之一，就是纸条的 {7/10}。

say.en: 3 counts the unshaded parts only. Look across the whole strip and count all 10 parts for the denominator.
say.zh: 分母写成 3，是只数了没涂色的部分。看整条纸条，分母要数全部 10 份。

say.en: You put the whole's count on top. Look at the 7 shaded parts for the numerator and all 10 parts for the denominator.
say.zh: 你把整体的份数写在上面了。分子数涂色的 7 份，分母数全部 10 份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the whole's equal parts first, then count the shaded parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数整体的相等部分，再数涂色份数。

reveal.en: Write {7/10}: 7 shaded parts out of the strip's 10 equal parts.
reveal.zh: 写成 {7/10}：纸条的 10 个相等部分中，涂了 7 份。

prompt.en: All 6 sixths are shaded. How many wholes is {6/6}?
prompt.zh: 6 个六分之一都涂了。{6/6} 是几个整体？

guide.en: Every equal part of the cake is shaded. Six sixths fill one whole cake, so write the number of whole cakes, not the number of parts.
guide.zh: 蛋糕的每一份都涂色了。6 个六分之一合起来是一个完整的蛋糕，要写几个整体，不是几份。

hints.en: Look at the whole cake. Is any part left unshaded?
hints.zh: 看整个蛋糕，还有没涂色的部分吗？

hints.en: All 6 parts together make the cake you started with.
hints.zh: 全部 6 份合起来，就是原来的整个蛋糕。

hints.en: There is 1 whole cake.
hints.zh: 这里有 1 个完整的蛋糕。

correct.en: Yes. All 6 sixths make one whole cake, so {6/6} = 1.
correct.zh: 对。全部 6 个六分之一合起来是一个完整的蛋糕，所以 {6/6} = 1。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the whole cake and count complete cakes, rather than its equal parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看整个蛋糕，数完整的蛋糕有几个，不是数它分成几份。

reveal.en: Write 1. All 6 out of 6 equal parts are shaded, so {6/6} is one whole.
reveal.zh: 写 1。6 个相等部分全涂了，所以 {6/6} 是 1 个整体。

text.en: 4 parts, each {1/7} of the strip
text.zh: 4 份，每份是纸条的 {1/7}

text.en: 4 parts, each {1/11} of the strip
text.zh: 4 份，每份是纸条的 {1/11}

text.en: 11 parts, each {1/4} of the strip
text.zh: 11 份，每份是纸条的 {1/4}

prompt.en: Which description means {4/11} of the strip?
prompt.zh: 哪一句表示纸条的 {4/11}？

guide.en: Look at how many equal parts make the whole strip to name one part. Then count how many of those parts are shaded.
guide.zh: 先看整条纸条平均分成几份，确定每份是几分之一。再数涂了这样的几份。

hints.en: Look at the whole strip, not just the 7 unshaded parts.
hints.zh: 看整条纸条，不是只看没涂色的 7 份。

hints.en: Each of the 11 equal parts is {1/11} of the strip.
hints.zh: 整体有 11 个相等部分，每份是纸条的 {1/11}。

hints.en: Choose the description with 4 one-elevenths.
hints.zh: 选表示 4 个 {1/11} 的那一句。

correct.en: Yes. {4/11} means 4 equal parts, each {1/11} of the whole strip.
correct.zh: 对。{4/11} 表示 4 个相等部分，每份是整条纸条的 {1/11}。

say.en: 7 counts only the unshaded parts. Look at all 11 equal parts: each part is {1/11}, not {1/7}.
say.zh: 分母写成 7，是只数了没涂色的份数。看全部 11 份：每份是 {1/11}，不是 {1/7}。

say.en: The two counts have changed places. Look at the whole's 11 equal parts and the 4 shaded parts.
say.zh: 两个数的位置反了。看整体的 11 个相等部分，以及涂色的 4 份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Name one of the whole's equal parts, then count how many are shaded.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先确定每份是几分之一，再数涂了这样的几份。

reveal.en: Choose B: 4 parts, each {1/11}. The whole has 11 equal parts and 4 are shaded.
reveal.zh: 选 B：4 份，每份是 {1/11}。整体有 11 个相等部分，涂了 4 份。

caption.en: A number line from 0 to 1 is as long as one whole strip. Here it is cut into 4 equal jumps.
caption.zh: 从 0 到 1 的数轴和一整条纸条一样长。这里把它平均分成 4 段。

caption.en: One jump from 0 lands on {1/4}: the fraction is a number with its own place on the line.
caption.zh: 从 0 跳 1 段，落在 {1/4}：分数也是一个数，在数轴上有自己的位置。

caption.en: Three jumps land on {3/4}. Count the jumps, not the marks: the mark at 0 is where you start.
caption.zh: 跳 3 段落在 {3/4}。数的是段数，不是刻度线：0 那条线是起点。

caption.en: Cut the line into 8 equal jumps and {5/8} is 5 jumps from 0, a little past the middle.
caption.zh: 把数轴平均分成 8 段，{5/8} 在离 0 有 5 段的地方，比中间多一点。

keyFacts.en: A fraction is a number with a place between 0 and 1.
keyFacts.zh: 分数是一个数，在 0 和 1 之间有自己的位置。

keyFacts.en: Count the jumps from 0, not the marks.
keyFacts.zh: 从 0 开始数段数，不数刻度线。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {1/4} on the number line.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在数轴上 {1/4} 的位置。

guide.en: The line from 0 to 1 is one whole, cut into 4 equal jumps. {1/4} is the end of the first jump. Count the jumps, not the marks.
guide.zh: 从 0 到 1 的这段是一个整体，平均分成 4 段。{1/4} 在第一段的终点。数的是段，不是刻度线。

hints.en: Start at 0. Each jump is {1/4} of the whole.
hints.zh: 从 0 出发，每一段是整体的 {1/4}。

hints.en: Make one jump from 0.
hints.zh: 从 0 跳一段。

correct.en: Yes. One jump of {1/4} from 0 lands on {1/4}.

say.en: Count the jumps between the marks, not the marks. 0 is where you start, before any jump.
say.zh: 数的是两条刻度线之间的段，不是刻度线。0 是起点，还没有跳。

fallback.en: Not yet. The marker should be one jump from 0.
fallback.zh: 还没对。标记应该在离 0 一段的地方。

reveal.en: {1/4} is one jump from 0, the first mark after 0.
reveal.zh: {1/4} 在离 0 一段的地方，也就是 0 后面的第一条刻度线。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {3/5}.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在 {3/5}。

guide.en: The whole from 0 to 1 has 5 equal jumps, so each jump is {1/5}. {3/5} is three jumps from 0.
guide.zh: 0 到 1 平均分成 5 段，每段是 {1/5}。{3/5} 是从 0 跳 3 段。

hints.en: How many jumps make the whole?
hints.zh: 几段合起来是一个整体？

hints.en: Count 3 jumps from 0.
hints.zh: 从 0 数 3 段。

correct.en: Yes. 3 jumps of {1/5} make {3/5}.

say.en: That is one jump off. Count the jumps between the marks, starting at 0.
say.zh: 差了一段。从 0 开始，数刻度线之间的段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at 0 and count 3 jumps.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 0 开始，数 3 段。

reveal.en: {3/5} is 3 jumps from 0.
reveal.zh: {3/5} 在离 0 三段的地方。

prompt.en: What fraction is the arrow pointing to?
prompt.zh: 箭头指着哪个分数？

guide.en: Count the equal jumps from 0 to 1: that is the bottom number. Count the jumps from 0 to the arrow: that is the top number.
guide.zh: 数一数 0 到 1 平均分成几段，这是分母；再数从 0 到箭头有几段，这是分子。

hints.en: How many equal jumps are there from 0 to 1?
hints.zh: 0 到 1 一共有几段？

hints.en: 8 jumps make the whole. How many jumps to the arrow?
hints.zh: 8 段是一个整体。到箭头有几段？

correct.en: Yes. The whole has 8 jumps and the arrow is 5 jumps from 0: {5/8}.
correct.zh: 对。整体是 8 段，箭头离 0 有 5 段：{5/8}。

say.en: You counted the marks. There are 9 marks but only 8 jumps from 0 to 1, and the arrow is 5 jumps along.
say.zh: 你数的是刻度线。0 到 1 有 9 条刻度线，但只有 8 段；箭头在第 5 段的终点。

say.en: The bottom number counts the jumps in the whole; the top number counts the jumps to the arrow.
say.zh: 分母数整体有几段，分子数到箭头有几段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count jumps, not marks: from 0 to 1, then from 0 to the arrow.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数段，不数刻度线：先数 0 到 1，再数 0 到箭头。

reveal.en: 8 jumps from 0 to 1, and the arrow is at the end of the 5th: {5/8}.
reveal.zh: 0 到 1 有 8 段，箭头在第 5 段的终点：{5/8}。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {1/2} on the number line.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在数轴上 {1/2} 的位置。

guide.en: The line from 0 to 1 is one whole, cut into 2 equal jumps. Each jump matches one half of the strip above. Start at 0 and count jumps between the marks.
guide.zh: 0 到 1 是一个整体，平均分成 2 段。每段和上面纸条的一半一样长。从 0 出发，数刻度线之间的段。

hints.en: Look at the whole from 0 to 1 and the strip above it.
hints.zh: 看看 0 到 1 这一段和上面的纸条。

hints.en: Each jump is {1/2}. Count one jump from 0.
hints.zh: 每段是 {1/2}。从 0 数一段。

hints.en: Stop at the middle mark, after one jump.
hints.zh: 跳一段，停在中间的刻度线上。

correct.en: Yes. One of the 2 equal jumps lands on {1/2}, halfway from 0 to 1.
correct.zh: 对。两段中的一段是 {1/2}，终点在 0 和 1 的正中间。

say.en: That is one jump too far. 0 is the starting mark; count the jump from 0 to the middle mark.
say.zh: 你多跳了一段。0 是起点；数从 0 到中间刻度线的那一段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the 2 equal jumps and count one from 0.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看这两段，从 0 数一段。

reveal.en: The whole has 2 equal jumps. One jump from 0 lands on the middle mark: {1/2}.
reveal.zh: 整体平均分成 2 段。从 0 跳一段，落在中间的刻度线上：{1/2}。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {2/3}.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在 {2/3} 的位置。

guide.en: The whole from 0 to 1 has 3 equal jumps. Each jump is {1/3}, so count 2 jumps from 0 to place {2/3}.
guide.zh: 0 到 1 平均分成 3 段。每段是 {1/3}，从 0 跳 2 段就是 {2/3}。

hints.en: Look at the gaps between the marks from 0 to 1.
hints.zh: 看看 0 到 1 的刻度线之间有几段。

hints.en: Start at 0 and count 2 jumps of {1/3}.
Stop one jump before 1.
hints.zh: 停在离 1 还有一段的地方。

correct.en: Yes. 2 of the 3 equal jumps take you from 0 to {2/3}.
correct.zh: 对。从 0 跳 3 段中的 2 段，就到 {2/3}。

say.en: You have made 3 jumps and reached 1. Count jumps from 0, and stop after 2 for {2/3}.
say.zh: 你跳了 3 段，到了 1。从 0 数段，跳 2 段就停，才是 {2/3}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at 0 and count 2 equal jumps to the right.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看起点 0，向右数 2 段。

reveal.en: Each jump is {1/3}. Two jumps from 0 land on {2/3}, one jump before 1.
reveal.zh: 每段是 {1/3}。从 0 跳两段就是 {2/3}，离 1 还差一段。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {5/6} on the number line.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在数轴上 {5/6} 的位置。

guide.en: The stretch from 0 to 1 has 6 equal jumps. The bottom number counts those 6 jumps; the top number tells you to make 5 jumps from 0.
guide.zh: 0 到 1 平均分成 6 段。分母数整体的 6 段；分子告诉你从 0 跳 5 段。

hints.en: Look at the equal jumps across the whole line.
hints.zh: 看看整个数轴上的相等的段。

hints.en: Each jump is {1/6}. Count 5 jumps from 0.
hints.zh: 每段是 {1/6}。从 0 数 5 段。

hints.en: The marker belongs at the last mark before 1.
hints.zh: 把标记放在 1 前面的最后一条刻度线上。

correct.en: Yes. 5 jumps of {1/6} land on {5/6}, with one jump left to reach 1.
correct.zh: 对。跳 5 段 {1/6} 就到 {5/6}，再跳一段才到 1。

say.en: That is 6 jumps from 0, one too many. Count the gaps between marks and stop after the fifth jump.
say.zh: 这里离 0 有 6 段，多了一段。数刻度线之间的段，跳到第 5 段的终点就停。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the jumps from 0; you need 5 of the 6 equal jumps.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 0 开始数段，你要跳 6 段中的 5 段。

reveal.en: The whole has 6 equal jumps. {5/6} is at the end of the fifth jump from 0.
reveal.zh: 整体平均分成 6 段。{5/6} 在从 0 起第 5 段的终点。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {7/12}.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在 {7/12} 的位置。

guide.en: The whole from 0 to 1 is cut into 12 equal jumps. Each jump is {1/12}; count 7 jumps from 0, keeping 0 as your starting point.
guide.zh: 0 到 1 平均分成 12 段。每段是 {1/12}；从 0 跳 7 段，0 只是起点。

hints.en: Look at the spaces between marks, including the first space after 0.
hints.zh: 看看刻度线之间的段，从 0 后面的第一段看起。

hints.en: Count 7 jumps of {1/12} from 0.
Stop at the seventh mark after 0.
hints.zh: 停在 0 后面的第 7 条刻度线上。

correct.en: Yes. 7 of the 12 equal jumps take you from 0 to {7/12}.
correct.zh: 对。从 0 跳 12 段中的 7 段，就到 {7/12}。

say.en: That is 8 jumps from 0, one too many. Look at the spaces between marks and count only 7 jumps.
say.zh: 这里离 0 有 8 段，多了一段。看刻度线之间的段，只数 7 段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at 0 and count the 7 jumps between marks.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 0 出发，数刻度线之间的 7 段。

reveal.en: Each jump is {1/12}. The end of the seventh jump from 0 is {7/12}.
reveal.zh: 每段是 {1/12}。从 0 起第 7 段的终点就是 {7/12}。

prompt.en: What fraction is the arrow pointing to?
prompt.zh: 箭头指着哪个分数？

guide.en: Count all the equal jumps from 0 to 1 for the bottom number. Count the jumps from 0 to the arrow for the top number. The marks show where jumps start and end.
guide.zh: 数 0 到 1 的所有段，写出分母。数 0 到箭头的段，写出分子。刻度线标出每段的起点和终点。

hints.en: Look at the jumps across the whole and the arrow's position.
hints.zh: 看看整体有几段，再看看箭头的位置。

hints.en: There are 4 equal jumps in the whole. Count from 0 to the arrow.
hints.zh: 整体有 4 段。从 0 数到箭头。

hints.en: The arrow is 3 jumps from 0. Write 3 above 4.
hints.zh: 箭头离 0 有 3 段。分子写 3，分母写 4。

correct.en: Yes. The whole has 4 equal jumps and the arrow is 3 jumps from 0: {3/4}.
correct.zh: 对。整体有 4 段，箭头离 0 有 3 段：{3/4}。

say.en: You counted marks, including 0. Look between them: there are 4 jumps in the whole and 3 to the arrow.
say.zh: 你数了刻度线，把 0 也算进去了。看线之间的段：整体有 4 段，到箭头有 3 段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the jumps from 0 to 1, then count from 0 to the arrow.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看 0 到 1 有几段，再数 0 到箭头有几段。

reveal.en: The whole has 4 jumps and the arrow is at the end of the third: {3/4}.
reveal.zh: 整体有 4 段，箭头在第 3 段的终点，所以是 {3/4}。

prompt.en: Write the fraction at the arrow.
prompt.zh: 写出箭头所指的分数。

guide.en: The strip above matches the whole from 0 to 1. Count all the equal jumps for the bottom number, including those beyond the arrow. Count from 0 to the arrow for the top number.
guide.zh: 上面的纸条和 0 到 1 这一整体一样长。分母数所有段，包括箭头后面的段。分子数从 0 到箭头有几段。

hints.en: Look at the full length from 0 to 1, not just the part after the arrow.
hints.zh: 看看 0 到 1 的全长，不只看箭头后面的部分。

hints.en: 7 equal jumps make the whole. Count the jumps from 0 to the arrow.
hints.zh: 7 段合起来是整体。数数从 0 到箭头有几段。

hints.en: The arrow is 2 jumps from 0. Write 2 above 7.
hints.zh: 箭头离 0 有 2 段。分子写 2，分母写 7。

correct.en: Yes. The arrow is 2 of the whole's 7 equal jumps from 0, so it points to {2/7}.
correct.zh: 对。整体有 7 段，箭头离 0 有 2 段，所以指着 {2/7}。

say.en: You counted the marks. Look between them: 8 marks make 7 jumps in the whole, and the arrow is 2 jumps from 0.
say.zh: 你数的是刻度线。看线之间的段：8 条线之间有 7 段，箭头离 0 有 2 段。

say.en: 5 counts only the jumps after the arrow. Look across the whole from 0 to 1: all 7 jumps belong in the bottom number.
say.zh: 分母写成 5，是只数了箭头后面的段。看整个 0 到 1：分母要数全部 7 段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look across the whole for the bottom number, then count jumps to the arrow for the top number.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看整体有几段来写分母，再数到箭头有几段来写分子。

reveal.en: There are 7 equal jumps from 0 to 1 and 2 from 0 to the arrow: {2/7}.
reveal.zh: 0 到 1 有 7 段，0 到箭头有 2 段，所以是 {2/7}。

prompt.en: What fraction is the arrow pointing to?
prompt.zh: 箭头指着哪个分数？

guide.en: Use the equal jumps from 0 to 1 to find the bottom number. Start at 0 and count jumps to the arrow to find the top number. 0 is your starting point, before any jump.
guide.zh: 数 0 到 1 的段来写分母。从 0 出发，数到箭头的段来写分子。0 是起点，还没有跳。

hints.en: Look at the whole line and the last jump before 1.
hints.zh: 看看整个数轴，还有 1 前面的最后一段。

hints.en: The whole has 10 equal jumps. Count how many end at or before the arrow.
hints.zh: 整体有 10 段。数数从 0 到箭头跳了几段。

hints.en: There are 9 jumps to the arrow and one more to 1. Write 9 above 10.
hints.zh: 到箭头有 9 段，再跳一段才到 1。分子写 9，分母写 10。

correct.en: Yes. The arrow is 9 jumps from 0 on a line with 10 equal jumps: {9/10}.
correct.zh: 对。整体有 10 段，箭头离 0 有 9 段：{9/10}。

say.en: You counted marks instead of jumps. Look between the 11 marks: there are 10 jumps in the whole and 9 to the arrow.
say.zh: 你数了刻度线。看 11 条线之间的段：整体有 10 段，到箭头有 9 段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the equal jumps across the whole, then the jumps from 0 to the arrow.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数整体有几段，再数从 0 到箭头有几段。

reveal.en: The whole has 10 equal jumps. The arrow is at the end of the ninth jump from 0, so it points to {9/10}.
reveal.zh: 整体平均分成 10 段。箭头在从 0 起第 9 段的终点，所以是 {9/10}。

caption.en: A fraction wall: every row is the same whole, cut into more equal parts the further down you go.
caption.zh: 这是一面分数墙：每一行都是同样大的整体，越往下，平均分的份数越多。

caption.en: {1/3} is one of 3 parts and {1/5} is one of 5. More parts in the same whole means smaller parts, so {1/3} is greater.
caption.zh: {1/3} 是 3 份中的 1 份，{1/5} 是 5 份中的 1 份。同一个整体分得越多，每份越小，所以 {1/3} 更大。

caption.en: With the same denominator the parts are the same size, so compare the numerators: 5 sevenths are more than 3 sevenths.
caption.zh: 分母相同，每份一样大，就比分子：5 个七分之一比 3 个七分之一多。

caption.en: Unit fractions in order, from the greatest: {1/2}, then {1/4}, then {1/8}.

keyFacts.en: Same whole, same numerator 1: the bigger denominator is the smaller fraction.
keyFacts.zh: 同一个整体、分子都是 1：分母越大，分数越小。

keyFacts.en: Same denominator: the bigger numerator is the greater fraction.
keyFacts.zh: 分母相同：分子越大，分数越大。

prompt.en: Which is greater, {1/3} or {1/5}? Tap it.

guide.en: Both rows are the same whole. Cutting the whole into more parts makes each part smaller, so the more parts, the smaller each one.
guide.zh: 这几行是同一个整体。整体分得越多，每一份就越小。

hints.en: Compare the width of one {1/3} piece with one {1/5} piece.
hints.zh: 比一比一块 {1/3} 和一块 {1/5} 有多宽。

hints.en: The same whole cut into 5 gives smaller parts than cut into 3.
hints.zh: 同一个整体分成 5 份，每份比分成 3 份时小。

correct.en: Yes. {1/3} is greater: the same whole cut into 3 gives bigger parts than cut into 5.
correct.zh: 对。{1/3} 大：同一个整体分成 3 份，每份比分成 5 份时大。

say.en: More parts in the same whole means each part is smaller. 5 is more than 3, but a fifth is smaller than a third.
say.zh: 同一个整体分的份数越多，每份越小。5 比 3 大，但五分之一比三分之一小。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the two pieces side by side under the same whole.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在同一个整体下面，把两块并排比一比。

reveal.en: {1/3} > {1/5}: a third is wider than a fifth of the same whole.
reveal.zh: {1/3} > {1/5}：同一个整体的三分之一比五分之一宽。

prompt.en: Order from greatest to smallest: {1/2}, {1/8}, {1/4}.

guide.en: All three are one part of the same whole. The fewer parts the whole is cut into, the bigger each part.
guide.zh: 三个都是同一个整体里的一份。整体分的份数越少，每份越大。

hints.en: Find each fraction's row on the wall.
hints.zh: 在分数墙上找到每个分数的那一行。

hints.en: {1/2} is the widest piece.
hints.zh: {1/2} 是最宽的一块。

correct.en: Yes. {1/2} > {1/4} > {1/8}: the fewer parts in the whole, the bigger each part.

say.en: That puts the biggest bottom number first. But eighths are the smallest pieces: more parts in the same whole means smaller parts.
say.zh: 这样排是把分母大的放在前面。但八分之一是最小的一块：同一个整体分得越多，每份越小。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start with the widest piece on the wall.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从分数墙上最宽的那块开始排。

guide.en: Both are sevenths, so the parts are the same size. Then the fraction with more parts is greater.
guide.zh: 两个都是七分之几，每份一样大。份数多的那个分数就大。

hints.en: Are the parts the same size in both bars?
hints.zh: 两条里的每一份一样大吗？

hints.en: 3 sevenths or 5 sevenths: which is more?
hints.zh: 3 个七分之一和 5 个七分之一，哪个多？

correct.en: Yes. {3/7} < {5/7}: same-size parts, and 3 parts are fewer than 5.

fallback.en: Not quite. The parts are the same size, so compare how many parts are shaded.
fallback.zh: 差一点。每份一样大，所以比一比涂了几份。

guide.en: Look at one piece in each row of the same whole. Cutting it into 6 equal parts makes each piece smaller than cutting it into 3.
guide.zh: 看同一个整体中每行的一份。平均分成 6 份时，每份比分成 3 份时小。

hints.en: Find the rows cut into 3 and 6 equal parts.
hints.zh: 找到平均分成 3 份和 6 份的两行。

hints.en: Compare the width of one piece in each row.
hints.zh: 比一比两行中一份的宽度。

hints.en: The sixth is narrower than the third. The wide side of the sign faces the greater fraction.
hints.zh: 六分之一比三分之一窄。符号开口的一边朝着大的分数。

correct.en: Yes. {1/6} < {1/3}: more equal parts in the same whole means smaller parts.
correct.zh: 对。{1/6} < {1/3}：同一个整体分得越多，每份越小。

say.en: 6 is more than 3, but sixths are smaller than thirds of the same whole. Look at the width of one piece in each row.
say.zh: 6 比 3 大，但同一个整体的六分之一比三分之一小。看看两行中一份的宽度。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at one sixth and one third on the wall, then turn the wide side towards the wider piece.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看分数墙上的六分之一和三分之一，让符号开口朝着较宽的一份。

reveal.en: Choose <: {1/6} < {1/3}, because a sixth is smaller than a third of the same whole.
reveal.zh: 选 <：{1/6} < {1/3}，因为同一个整体的六分之一比三分之一小。

prompt.en: Which is smaller, {1/4} or {1/9}? Tap it.

guide.en: The two whole ribbons are the same length. Compare one of 4 equal pieces with one of 9 equal pieces.
guide.zh: 两条完整的丝带一样长。比一比分成 4 份和分成 9 份时的一份。

hints.en: Check that the whole ribbons are the same length.
hints.zh: 看看两条完整的丝带是不是一样长。

hints.en: More equal pieces in the same whole means shorter pieces.
hints.zh: 同一个整体平均分的份数越多，每份越短。

hints.en: One ninth is shorter than one quarter.
hints.zh: 九分之一比四分之一短。

correct.en: Yes. {1/9} is smaller: dividing the same ribbon into 9 gives shorter pieces than dividing it into 4.
correct.zh: 对。{1/9} 小：同样长的丝带平均分成 9 份，每份比分成 4 份时短。

say.en: A larger denominator means more equal pieces, not longer pieces. Look at the shaded ninth beside the shaded quarter.
say.zh: 分母越大，平均分的份数越多，每份就越短。比一比涂出的九分之一和四分之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the lengths of the shaded pieces in these equal-length ribbons.
fallback.zh: 还没对。两条丝带一样长，比一比涂出的那一份有多长。

reveal.en: Tap {1/9}. A ninth is shorter than a quarter of the same whole, so {1/9} < {1/4}.
reveal.zh: 点 {1/9}。同一个整体的九分之一比四分之一短，所以 {1/9} < {1/4}。

prompt.en: Which is greater, {6/10} or {4/10}? Tap it.

guide.en: Both chocolate bars are the same size and cut into 10 equal parts. Each part is the same size, so compare how many parts are shaded.
guide.zh: 两条巧克力一样大，都平均分成 10 份。每份一样大，就比涂了几份。

hints.en: Look at the equal-sized parts in both bars.
hints.zh: 看看两条巧克力中一样大的每一份。

hints.en: Count the shaded tenths: one bar has 6, the other has 4.
hints.zh: 数一数涂出的十分之一：一条有 6 份，另一条有 4 份。

correct.en: Yes. {6/10} > {4/10}: 6 tenths are more than 4 tenths of the same whole.
correct.zh: 对。{6/10} > {4/10}：同一个整体中，6 个十分之一比 4 个十分之一多。

fallback.en: Not yet. The parts are the same size. Look at which bar has more shaded parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每份一样大，看看哪条涂出的份数多。

reveal.en: Tap {6/10}. Both fractions count tenths, and 6 parts are more than 4.
reveal.zh: 点 {6/10}。两个分数都是十分之几，6 份比 4 份多。

prompt.en: Order from smallest to greatest: {1/5}, {1/10}, {1/2}, {1/7}.

guide.en: Each fraction names one part of the same whole. Compare the widths of those parts, starting with the narrowest.
guide.zh: 每个分数都是同一个整体中的一份。比一比每份的宽度，从最窄的开始排。

hints.en: Find the rows for all four fractions.
hints.zh: 找到这四个分数对应的行。

hints.en: The numerators are all 1, but the parts have different widths. More equal parts means narrower pieces.
hints.zh: 分子都是 1，但每份的宽度不同。平均分的份数越多，每份越窄。

hints.en: Start with {1/10}, then {1/7}.

correct.en: Yes. {1/10} < {1/7} < {1/5} < {1/2}: fewer equal parts in the same whole means wider pieces.

say.en: All the numerators are 1, but one part is not the same size in every row. Look at the widths: the row with more equal parts has narrower pieces.
say.zh: 分子都是 1，但各行的一份不是一样大。看看宽度：同一个整体平均分的份数越多，每份越窄。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the narrowest single piece on the wall and put its fraction first.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在分数墙上找最窄的一份，把它对应的分数排在最前面。

reveal.en: The order is {1/10}, {1/7}, {1/5}, {1/2}. The pieces get wider as the whole is cut into fewer parts.
reveal.zh: 顺序是 {1/10}、{1/7}、{1/5}、{1/2}。同一个整体平均分的份数越少，每份越宽。

prompt.en: Order from greatest to smallest: {2/8}, {7/8}, {5/8}.

guide.en: All three fractions count eighths of the same whole. The parts are the same size, so put the fraction with the most parts first.
guide.zh: 三个分数都是同一个整体的八分之几。每份一样大，把份数最多的分数排在最前面。

hints.en: Look at the row cut into 8 equal parts.
hints.zh: 看看平均分成 8 份的那一行。

hints.en: Compare the numbers of eighths: 2, 7 and 5.
hints.zh: 比一比各有几个八分之一：2 个、7 个和 5 个。

hints.en: 7 eighths are the most, and 2 eighths are the fewest.
hints.zh: 7 个八分之一最多，2 个八分之一最少。

correct.en: Yes. {7/8} > {5/8} > {2/8}: the parts are the same size, so more parts means a greater fraction.

fallback.en: Not yet. Count eighths of the same whole. Start with the fraction that has the most parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数同一个整体中的八分之一，从份数最多的分数开始排。

reveal.en: The order is {7/8}, {5/8}, {2/8}, because 7 eighths are more than 5 eighths, and 5 are more than 2.
reveal.zh: 顺序是 {7/8}、{5/8}、{2/8}，因为 7 个八分之一比 5 个多，5 个又比 2 个多。

text.en: {1/12} is greater because 12 is more than 8.
{1/8} is greater because fewer equal parts in the same whole means larger parts.
text.zh: {1/8} 大，因为同一个整体平均分的份数较少，每份较大。

prompt.en: Which is greater in the same whole? Choose the fraction and reason.
prompt.zh: 同一个整体中，哪个分数大？选出分数和理由。

guide.en: Compare {1/8} and {1/12} as parts of the same whole. Choose the sentence that explains how the number of equal parts affects their size.
guide.zh: 把 {1/8} 和 {1/12} 放在同一个整体中比较。想一想，平均分的份数怎样影响每份的大小。

hints.en: Look at the two fractions. Each takes one equal part.
hints.zh: 看看两个分数，都取了平均分后的一份。

hints.en: Cutting the same whole into more equal parts makes each part smaller.
hints.zh: 同一个整体平均分的份数越多，每份越小。

hints.en: One of 8 equal parts is larger than one of 12.
hints.zh: 同一个整体的八等份中的一份，比十二等份中的一份大。

correct.en: Yes. {1/8} is greater because the same whole is cut into fewer equal parts, making each part larger.
correct.zh: 对。{1/8} 大，因为同一个整体平均分的份数较少，每份就较大。

say.en: 12 is more than 8, but it counts more equal parts in the same whole. Look at how this makes each twelfth smaller than each eighth.
say.zh: 12 比 8 大，表示同一个整体平均分的份数更多。想一想，这样每个十二分之一就比八分之一小。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at how many equal parts each whole is cut into, then compare one part.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每个整体平均分成几份，再比一比其中的一份。

reveal.en: Choose {1/8} with the reason about fewer equal parts. An eighth is larger than a twelfth of the same whole.
reveal.zh: 选 {1/8} 和“平均分的份数较少”这个理由。同一个整体的八分之一比十二分之一大。

text.en: The whole bars are equal in length, so the longer shaded half shows {1/2} > {1/4}.
text.zh: 两条完整的条一样长，涂出的二分之一较长，说明 {1/2} > {1/4}。

text.en: The shaded quarter is longer, so {1/4} is greater than {1/2}.
text.zh: 涂出的四分之一较长，所以 {1/4} 比 {1/2} 大。

prompt.en: Which picture and reason compare {1/2} and {1/4} using the same whole?
prompt.zh: 哪幅图和理由用同一个整体比较 {1/2} 和 {1/4}？

guide.en: Check the length of each whole bar before comparing its shaded part. Choose the picture and sentence that use the same whole.
guide.zh: 先看每条完整的条有多长，再比涂出的部分。选出用同一个整体比较的图和理由。

hints.en: Compare the full lengths of the two bars in each picture.
hints.zh: 比一比每幅图中两条完整的条有多长。

hints.en: Use equal-length whole bars, so a half and a quarter refer to the same whole.
hints.zh: 用一样长的完整条，让二分之一和四分之一对应同一个整体。

hints.en: In equal-length bars, the shaded half is longer than the shaded quarter.
hints.zh: 两条完整的条一样长时，涂出的二分之一比四分之一长。

correct.en: Yes. Equal-length bars show the same whole. A half is larger than a quarter of that whole.
correct.zh: 对。一样长的完整条表示同一个整体，这个整体的二分之一比四分之一大。

say.en: The quarter looks longer because its whole bar is longer. Compare the full bars, then use equal-length wholes to compare {1/2} and {1/4}.
say.zh: 四分之一看起来较长，是因为它的完整条较长。看看两条完整的条，再用一样长的整体比较 {1/2} 和 {1/4}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the full length of each bar. Choose the picture whose whole bars are equal in length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看每条完整的条有多长，选两条完整条一样长的图。

reveal.en: Choose picture A: its whole bars have equal lengths, and {1/2} > {1/4}. Picture B uses different-sized wholes.
reveal.zh: 选图 A：两条完整的条一样长，{1/2} > {1/4}。图 B 的两个整体大小不同。

caption.en: {2/7} of a strip is shaded: 2 parts of 7 equal parts.
caption.zh: 纸条涂了 {2/7}：7 等份中的 2 份。

caption.en: Add {3/7}: 3 more parts of the same size. Now 5 parts are shaded.
caption.zh: 再加 {3/7}：再涂 3 份同样大的部分。现在涂了 5 份。

caption.en: The parts are still sevenths, so the denominator stays 7. Only the number of parts changes: 2 + 3 = 5.
caption.zh: 每份还是七分之一，所以分母还是 7。变的只是份数：2 + 3 = 5。

caption.en: Taking away works the same way. Start with {7/9} …
caption.zh: 减法也一样。先看 {7/9} ……

caption.en: … and take away 4 ninths. 3 ninths are left: ninths minus ninths are still ninths.
caption.zh: ……拿走 4 个九分之一，还剩 3 个九分之一：九分之几减九分之几，还是九分之几。

keyFacts.en: Like fractions: add or take away the numerators; the denominator stays.
keyFacts.zh: 同分母分数相加减：分子相加减，分母不变。

keyFacts.en: The size of the parts does not change, only their number.
keyFacts.zh: 每份的大小不变，变的只是份数。

prompt.en: Shade {3/7} more, then write {2/7} + {3/7}.

guide.en: The parts are all sevenths, the same size. Adding puts more sevenths together. The size of each part does not change, so the bottom number stays 7.
guide.zh: 每一份都是七分之一，大小一样。相加就是把七分之几合在一起。每份的大小不变，所以分母还是 7。

hints.en: Shade 3 more parts next to the given ones.
hints.zh: 在已经给出的部分旁边，再涂 3 份。

hints.en: Count all the shaded parts. How big is each part?
hints.zh: 数一数一共涂了几份。每份有多大？

hints.en: 5 parts, each one seventh.
hints.zh: 5 份，每份是七分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {2/7} + {3/7} = {5/7}. Sevenths plus sevenths are still sevenths.
correct.zh: 对。{2/7} + {3/7} = {5/7}。七分之几加七分之几，还是七分之几。

say.en: Sevenths plus sevenths are still sevenths. Only the number of parts changes: the bottom number stays 7.
say.zh: 七分之几加七分之几，还是七分之几。变的只是份数，分母仍是 7。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the parts that are shaded now. Each one is a seventh.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数现在涂了几份，每份是七分之一。

reveal.en: 2 sevenths and 3 more sevenths are 5 sevenths: {5/7}.
reveal.zh: 2 个七分之一再加 3 个七分之一，是 5 个七分之一：{5/7}。

prompt.en: Take away {4/9}: tap 4 shaded parts. Then write {7/9} − {4/9}.

guide.en: Taking away ninths leaves ninths. Cross out the parts you take away, then count the shaded parts that are left.
guide.zh: 从九分之几里拿走九分之几，剩下的还是九分之几。先划掉拿走的份，再数剩下的涂色部分。

hints.en: Tap 4 of the shaded parts to cross them out.
hints.zh: 点 4 份涂色部分，把它们划掉。

hints.en: How many shaded parts are left? Each one is a ninth.
hints.zh: 还剩几份涂色部分？每份是九分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {7/9} − {4/9} = {3/9}. The parts are still ninths.

say.en: Taking away ninths leaves ninths: the bottom number stays 9. Only the number of parts changes.
say.zh: 拿走九分之几，剩下的还是九分之几，分母仍是 9。变的只是份数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the shaded parts that are not crossed out.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数没有被划掉的涂色部分。

reveal.en: 7 ninths take away 4 ninths leaves 3 ninths: {3/9}.
reveal.zh: 7 个九分之一拿走 4 个，剩下 3 个九分之一：{3/9}。

prompt.en: Shade {1/3} more, then write {1/3} + {1/3}.

guide.en: Look at the circle's 3 equal parts. Shade one more part and count all the shaded parts. Each part stays one third, so the denominator stays 3.
guide.zh: 看看圆的 3 等份。再涂 1 份，数一数一共涂了几份。每份仍是三分之一，所以分母还是 3。

hints.en: Look at the shaded part and the two unshaded parts.
hints.zh: 看看已涂的 1 份和没涂的 2 份。

hints.en: Shade one unshaded part, then count the shaded thirds.
hints.zh: 把没涂的部分再涂 1 份，然后数涂色的三分之一。

hints.en: You now have 2 parts out of 3 equal parts.
hints.zh: 现在涂了 3 等份中的 2 份。

correct.en: Yes. {1/3} + {1/3} = {2/3}. The parts are still thirds.

say.en: You added the denominators too. Look at the circle: it still has 3 equal parts, so keep 3 below the fraction line.
say.zh: 你把分母也相加了。看看圆：仍是 3 等份，所以分母保持 3。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the shaded parts and all the equal parts in the circle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数涂色的份数，再数圆的全部等份。

reveal.en: 1 third and 1 more third make 2 thirds: {1/3} + {1/3} = {2/3}.

prompt.en: Shade {2/5} more of the ribbon, then write {2/5} + {2/5}.
prompt.zh: 把丝带再涂 {2/5}，然后写出 {2/5} + {2/5} 的结果。

guide.en: The ribbon has 5 equal parts, with 2 already shaded. Shade 2 more parts and count the shaded fifths. Adding parts does not change their size.
guide.zh: 丝带平均分成 5 份，已经涂了 2 份。再涂 2 份，数一数涂色的五分之一。增加份数不会改变每份的大小。

hints.en: Look at the 2 given parts of the ribbon.
hints.zh: 看看丝带已经给出的 2 份。

hints.en: Shade 2 more parts. Add the shaded counts and keep the denominator 5.
hints.zh: 再涂 2 份。把涂色的份数相加，分母保持 5。

hints.en: 4 of the ribbon's 5 equal parts will be shaded.
hints.zh: 丝带的 5 等份中，会有 4 份涂色。

correct.en: Yes. {2/5} + {2/5} = {4/5}. Four parts are shaded, and each is still a fifth.

say.en: You doubled the denominator. Look at the ribbon: it has not been cut again, so there are still 5 equal parts.
say.zh: 你把分母加倍了。看看丝带：没有重新分，仍是 5 等份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the given parts and the parts you added, using the same 5-part ribbon.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在这条 5 等份的丝带上，数原有的份和你再涂的份。

reveal.en: 2 fifths and 2 more fifths make 4 fifths: {4/5}. The denominator stays 5.
reveal.zh: 2 个五分之一再加 2 个，是 4 个五分之一：{4/5}。分母保持 5。

prompt.en: Cross out {1/4} of the prata, then write {3/4} − {1/4}.
prompt.zh: 划掉prata的 {1/4}，再写出 {3/4} − {1/4} 的结果。

guide.en: Start with the 3 shaded quarters. Cross out one of them and count the quarters left. The whole prata still has 4 equal parts.
guide.zh: 从涂色的 3 个四分之一开始。划掉其中 1 份，再数剩下的份。整个prata仍分成 4 等份。

hints.en: Look at the 3 shaded parts of the prata.
hints.zh: 看看prata涂色的 3 份。

hints.en: Cross out one shaded part. Count only the shaded parts that remain.
hints.zh: 划掉 1 份涂色部分，只数剩下的涂色部分。

hints.en: 2 quarters remain, and the denominator stays 4.
hints.zh: 还剩 2 个四分之一，分母保持 4。

correct.en: Yes. {3/4} − {1/4} = {2/4}. Taking away a quarter leaves quarters.
correct.zh: 对。{3/4} − {1/4} = {2/4}。拿走四分之一，剩下的每份还是四分之一。

say.en: You subtracted the denominators too. Look at the whole prata: it still has 4 equal parts, so keep the denominator 4.
say.zh: 你把分母也相减了。看看整个prata：仍是 4 等份，分母保持 4。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shaded parts that have not been crossed out. Each is a quarter.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看没有划掉的涂色部分，每份是四分之一。

reveal.en: 3 quarters take away 1 quarter leaves 2 quarters: {3/4} − {1/4} = {2/4}.

prompt.en: Cross out {5/12}, then write {11/12} − {5/12}.

guide.en: The strip has 12 equal parts and 11 are shaded. Cross out 5 shaded parts, then count those left. You are still counting twelfths.
guide.zh: 纸条平均分成 12 份，涂了 11 份。划掉 5 份涂色部分，再数剩下的份。每份仍是十二分之一。

hints.en: Look at the shaded parts, leaving the unshaded part alone.
hints.zh: 看看涂色部分，不要动没涂的那一份。

hints.en: Cross out 5 of the 11 shaded parts. Keep 12 as the denominator.
hints.zh: 在涂色的 11 份中划掉 5 份，分母保持 12。

hints.en: 11 − 5 leaves 6 parts, each one twelfth.
hints.zh: 11 − 5 剩下 6 份，每份是十二分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {11/12} − {5/12} = {6/12}. The 6 parts left are still twelfths.

say.en: You subtracted the denominators. Look at the strip's cuts: the whole still has 12 equal parts, so its denominator stays 12.
say.zh: 你把分母相减了。看看纸条的分格：整个纸条仍是 12 等份，分母保持 12。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the shaded parts left after crossing out 5. Use the strip's 12 equal parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数划掉 5 份后剩下的涂色部分，整个纸条有 12 等份。

reveal.en: 11 twelfths take away 5 twelfths leaves 6 twelfths: {6/12}.
reveal.zh: 11 个十二分之一拿走 5 个，剩下 6 个十二分之一：{6/12}。

prompt.en: Write {3/8} + {5/8}. How much of the circle is shaded in all?
prompt.zh: 写出 {3/8} + {5/8}。圆一共涂了几分之几？

guide.en: Look at the 3 given parts and the 5 added parts. Count them together, keeping 8 as the denominator. All 8 eighths make one whole.
guide.zh: 看看原有的 3 份和加上的 5 份。把份数相加，分母保持 8。8 个八分之一就是一个整体。

hints.en: Look for any unshaded parts of the circle.
hints.zh: 看看圆里还有没有没涂色的部分。

hints.en: Add 3 and 5. Each part is still one eighth.
hints.zh: 把 3 和 5 相加，每份仍是八分之一。

hints.en: 8 eighths make one whole. Keep 8 below the fraction line.
hints.zh: 8 个八分之一是一个整体，分数线下面仍写 8。

correct.en: Yes. {3/8} + {5/8} = {8/8}, one whole. All 8 equal parts are shaded.

say.en: You added the denominators too. Look at the circle: it has 8 equal parts, not 16, and all 8 are shaded.
say.zh: 你把分母也相加了。看看圆：是 8 等份，不是 16 等份，而且全部涂了色。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the shaded eighths and compare that count with the circle's 8 equal parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数全部涂色的八分之一，再看看整个圆的 8 等份。

reveal.en: 3 eighths and 5 eighths make 8 eighths: {8/8}, which is one whole.
reveal.zh: 3 个八分之一加 5 个，是 8 个八分之一：{8/8}，就是一个整体。

prompt.en: Write {9/11} − {6/11}. How much is left?

guide.en: Look at the 9 shaded parts of the strip. Imagine taking away 6 of them, then count those left. Each part stays one eleventh, so keep the denominator 11.
guide.zh: 看看纸条涂色的 9 份。想一想拿走其中 6 份，还剩几份。每份仍是十一分之一，所以分母保持 11。

hints.en: Look at the 9 given parts and the strip's 11 equal parts.
hints.zh: 看看给出的 9 份和整个纸条的 11 等份。

hints.en: Subtract 6 from 9. Keep the size of each part the same.
hints.zh: 用 9 减 6，每份的大小保持不变。

hints.en: 3 parts remain, each one eleventh.
hints.zh: 剩下 3 份，每份是十一分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {9/11} − {6/11} = {3/11}. Taking away parts leaves 3 elevenths.

say.en: You subtracted the denominators too. Look at the whole strip: its 11 equal parts stay the same, so keep 11 below the line.
say.zh: 你把分母也相减了。看看整个纸条：仍是 11 等份，分数线下面保持 11。

say.en: You put the whole's part count on top. Look at the strip: 3 parts remain, so 3 goes on top and 11 goes below.
say.zh: 你把整体的份数写在上面了。看看纸条：剩下 3 份，所以分子是 3，分母是 11。

fallback.en: Not yet. Work out how many of the 9 shaded parts remain after taking away 6. Each is an eleventh.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想一想涂色的 9 份拿走 6 份后剩几份，每份是十一分之一。

reveal.en: 9 − 6 = 3. The parts remain elevenths, so {9/11} − {6/11} = {3/11}.

prompt.en: Siti ate {2/10} and Ravi {3/10} of one chocolate bar. How much altogether?
prompt.zh: Siti 吃巧克力的 {2/10}，Ravi 吃 {3/10}。共吃了几分之几？

guide.en: Use the model of one whole chocolate bar. Both amounts are tenths, so add the 2 parts and the 3 parts. The denominator stays 10 because the parts stay the same size.
guide.zh: 看表示一整条巧克力的模型图。两人吃的都是十分之几，所以把 2 份和 3 份相加。每份大小不变，分母保持 10。

hints.en: Look at the two amounts under the brace marked with a question mark.
hints.zh: 看看问号括号下的两人各自吃的部分。

hints.en: Add 2 tenths and 3 tenths, using the same whole chocolate bar.
hints.zh: 在同一条巧克力上，把 2 个十分之一和 3 个十分之一相加。

hints.en: They ate 5 parts, each one tenth of the whole bar.
hints.zh: 两人共吃了 5 份，每份是整条巧克力的十分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {2/10} + {3/10} = {5/10}. They ate 5 tenths of the same chocolate bar.
correct.zh: 对。{2/10} + {3/10} = {5/10}。两人共吃了同一条巧克力的十分之五。

say.en: You added the denominators too. Look at the whole bar: both amounts use its same 10 equal parts, so keep the denominator 10.
say.zh: 你把分母也相加了。看看整条巧克力：两人吃的都来自同样的 10 等份，分母保持 10。

say.en: You used the 5 parts left as the denominator. Look at the entire bar: the denominator counts all 10 parts, eaten and left.
say.zh: 你把剩下的 5 份当作分母了。看看整条巧克力：分母要数吃掉和剩下的全部 10 份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Add the two amounts under the brace. Count their parts out of the whole bar's 10 equal parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把括号下两人吃的份数相加，整个巧克力条有 10 等份。

reveal.en: Siti's 2 tenths and Ravi's 3 tenths make 5 tenths: {2/10} + {3/10} = {5/10}.
reveal.zh: Siti 吃的 2 个十分之一加 Ravi 吃的 3 个，共 5 个十分之一：{2/10} + {3/10} = {5/10}。

caption.en: Shade half of a paper strip: {1/2}.
caption.zh: 把纸条涂上一半：{1/2}。

caption.en: Fold it in half again. Every part is cut into 2, the shaded half too: 2 of 4 parts.
caption.zh: 再对折一次。每一份都分成了 2 份，涂色的那一半也一样：4 份中的 2 份。

caption.en: Fold once more: 4 of 8 parts. The shaded amount has not changed, only its name.
caption.zh: 再折一次：8 份中的 4 份。涂色的多少没有变，变的只是名字。

caption.en: On the fraction wall the three line up exactly. Fractions that name the same amount are equivalent fractions.
caption.zh: 在分数墙上，这三个正好一样长。表示同样多的分数叫等值分数。

caption.en: Cut each of the 3 parts of {2/3} into 4 and you get {8/12}: the top and the bottom are both multiplied by 4.
caption.zh: 把 {2/3} 的每一份都分成 4 小份，就得到 {8/12}：分子和分母都乘 4。

keyFacts.en: Equivalent fractions name the same amount.
keyFacts.zh: 等值分数表示同样多。

keyFacts.en: Multiply the numerator and the denominator by the same number.
keyFacts.zh: 分子和分母同时乘同一个数。

keyFacts.en: Never add the same number to both: that changes the amount.
keyFacts.zh: 不能给分子分母加同一个数：那样多少就变了。

prompt.en: Fold the strip twice more. Then write the shaded part in eighths.
prompt.zh: 把纸条再对折两次，然后用八分之几写出涂色部分。

guide.en: Folding cuts every part in two, the shaded parts too. The number of parts and the number of shaded parts both double, but the shaded amount stays the same.
guide.zh: 每折一次，每一份都被分成两份，涂色的部分也一样。总份数和涂色的份数都变成 2 倍，涂色的多少不变。

hints.en: Press Fold two times.
hints.zh: 按两次「对折」。

hints.en: Count all the parts, then the shaded ones.
hints.zh: 先数全部的份数，再数涂色的份数。

hints.en: 8 parts, 4 of them shaded.
hints.zh: 一共 8 份，涂了 4 份。

correct.en: Yes. {1/2} = {2/4} = {4/8}: the same amount of strip, with more and smaller parts.
correct.zh: 对。{1/2} = {2/4} = {4/8}：涂色的纸条一样多，只是份更多、更小。

say.en: The shaded half was folded too, so it is now 4 parts, not 1. Count the shaded parts again.
say.zh: 涂色的一半也被折了，现在是 4 份，不是 1 份。再数一数涂色的份数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the parts now, then the shaded parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数现在一共几份，再数涂色的有几份。

reveal.en: After two more folds the strip has 8 parts and the shaded half is 4 of them: {4/8}.
reveal.zh: 再折两次，纸条有 8 份，涂色的一半占其中 4 份：{4/8}。

prompt.en: Cut every part to make twelfths, then write the shaded part.
prompt.zh: 把每份再平均分，变成十二分之几，再写出涂色部分。

guide.en: 3 parts × 4 = 12 parts. When every part is cut into 4, each shaded part is cut into 4 as well, so the 2 shaded parts become 8.
guide.zh: 3 份 × 4 = 12 份。每份都分成 4 小份，涂色的每一份也分成 4 小份，所以 2 份变成 8 份。

hints.en: 3 times what makes 12?
hints.zh: 3 乘几等于 12？

hints.en: Choose ×4.
The shaded part is now 8 small parts out of 12.
hints.zh: 现在涂色部分是 12 小份中的 8 份。

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} = {8/12}. The top and the bottom were both multiplied by 4, because every part was cut into 4.
correct.zh: 对。{2/3} = {8/12}。分子和分母都乘 4，因为每一份都被分成了 4 份。

say.en: You cut every part, so the shaded parts were cut too: the top and the bottom both change.
say.zh: 每一份都分了，涂色的部分也分了：分子和分母都要变。

fallback.en: Not yet. Which choice turns 3 parts into 12?
fallback.zh: 还没对。选哪一个能把 3 份变成 12 份？

reveal.en: ×4 cuts each third into 4 twelfths: {2/3} = {8/12}.
reveal.zh: 选 ×4，每个三分之一变成 4 个十二分之一：{2/3} = {8/12}。

prompt.en: Fill in the boxes: {2/3} = {?/12} = {8/?}.

guide.en: To rename a fraction, multiply the top and the bottom by the same number. 3 × 4 = 12, so 2 × 4 = 8. And if the top is 2 × 4 = 8, the bottom is 3 × 4 = 12.
guide.zh: 给分数换名字，分子和分母要乘同一个数。3 × 4 = 12，所以 2 × 4 = 8；分子是 2 × 4 = 8，分母就是 3 × 4 = 12。

hints.en: What do you multiply 3 by to get 12?
hints.zh: 3 乘几得 12？

hints.en: Multiply the top by the same number.
hints.zh: 分子也乘同一个数。

hints.en: Times 4 each time.
hints.zh: 每次都是乘 4。

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} = {8/12}: the top and the bottom are both multiplied by 4.

say.en: Renaming multiplies; it does not add. 3 × 4 = 12, so the top is 2 × 4. Adding the same number to the top and the bottom changes the amount.
say.zh: 换名字要用乘法，不是加法。3 × 4 = 12，所以分子是 2 × 4。分子分母加上同一个数，分数的大小就变了。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the number 3 was multiplied by, and multiply 2 by it too.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看 3 乘了几，2 也乘同一个数。

reveal.en: × 4 on the top and the bottom: {2/3} = {8/12}.

prompt.en: Fold the strip once. Then write the shaded part in sixths.
prompt.zh: 把纸条对折一次，再用六分之几写出涂色部分。

guide.en: Look at the shaded third of the strip. Folding cuts every part into 2, including the shaded part, so both counts double while the amount stays the same.
guide.zh: 看看纸条上涂色的三分之一。对折把每份都分成 2 小份，涂色的那份也一样，所以总份数和涂色份数都变成 2 倍，多少不变。

hints.en: Look at the 3 equal parts and the 1 shaded part.
hints.zh: 看看原来的 3 等份和涂色的 1 份。

hints.en: Press Fold once, then count all the parts and the shaded parts.
hints.zh: 按一次「对折」，再数总份数和涂色份数。

hints.en: There are now 6 equal parts, with 2 shaded.
hints.zh: 现在有 6 等份，其中 2 份涂色。

correct.en: Yes. {1/3} = {2/6}: every part was halved, so the top and the bottom both doubled.
correct.zh: 对。{1/3} = {2/6}：每份都分成两份，所以分子和分母都乘 2。

say.en: Adding 3 to both numbers gives {4/6}, which is more than a third. Look at how folding doubles both counts.
say.zh: 分子分母都加 3 得到 {4/6}，比三分之一多。看看对折后两种份数怎样都变成 2 倍。

say.en: The shaded part was folded too, so it is now 2 small parts. Count the shaded parts again.
say.zh: 涂色的那份也被折了，现在是 2 小份。再数一数涂色份数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Fold once, then count the equal parts and the shaded parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。对折一次，再数全部的等份和涂色的份数。

reveal.en: One fold makes 3 × 2 = 6 parts and 1 × 2 = 2 shaded parts: {1/3} = {2/6}.

prompt.en: Split each part to make twelfths. Then write the shaded fraction.
prompt.zh: 把每份再平均分，得到十二等份，再写出涂色分数。

guide.en: The ribbon has 4 equal parts, with 3 shaded. Split every part into the same number of pieces to make 12 parts, and multiply the shaded count by that number too.
guide.zh: 丝带有 4 等份，其中 3 份涂色。把每份分成同样多的小份，使总份数变成 12，涂色份数也乘同一个数。

hints.en: Look at the 4 parts and the 12 parts you need.
hints.zh: 看看原来的 4 份和要得到的 12 份。

hints.en: Find the factor in 4 × ? = 12, then use it for the shaded parts too.
hints.zh: 想想 4 × 几 = 12，涂色份数也乘这个数。

hints.en: Choose ×3: 3 shaded parts become 9 small parts.
hints.zh: 选「×3」：涂色的 3 份变成 9 小份。

correct.en: Yes. {3/4} = {9/12}: splitting every quarter into 3 multiplies both counts by 3.
correct.zh: 对。{3/4} = {9/12}：每个四分之一分成 3 小份，分子和分母都乘 3。

say.en: The 3 shaded quarters were split too, so keeping 3 on top loses shaded pieces. Count all the shaded pieces.
say.zh: 涂色的 3 个四分之一也被分了，分子仍写 3 就漏数了。数一数全部涂色小份。

say.en: Adding 8 to both numbers gives {11/12} and changes the amount. Look at how each quarter becomes 3 pieces.
say.zh: 分子分母都加 8 得到 {11/12}，多少变了。看看每个四分之一怎样变成 3 小份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the choice that turns 4 parts into 12, then count the shaded parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出能把 4 份变成 12 份的选项，再数涂色份数。

reveal.en: Choose ×3. The whole has 4 × 3 = 12 parts and the shaded amount has 3 × 3 = 9: {9/12}.

prompt.en: Fill in the missing top number: {2/5} = {?/10}.

guide.en: Look at the 5 equal parts of the prata. To name the same amount in tenths, multiply the bottom by 2 and the top by 2 too.
guide.zh: 看看prata的 5 等份。要用十分之几表示同样多，分母乘 2，分子也乘 2。

hints.en: Compare the bottom numbers, 5 and 10.
hints.zh: 比较分母 5 和 10。

hints.en: 5 × 2 = 10, so multiply the top by 2 too.
hints.zh: 5 × 2 = 10，所以分子也乘 2。

hints.en: The missing top number is 2 × 2.
hints.zh: 缺少的分子是 2 × 2。

correct.en: Yes. {2/5} = {4/10}: the top and the bottom are both multiplied by 2.

say.en: Adding 5 to both numbers gives {7/10}, which is a different amount. Look for the multiplier from 5 to 10.
say.zh: 分子分母都加 5 得到 {7/10}，多少变了。看看 5 乘几得到 10。

say.en: Only the bottom changed in {2/10}. Each shaded fifth becomes 2 tenths, so count the shaded pieces again.
say.zh: {2/10} 只改了分母。每个涂色的五分之一变成 2 个十分之一，再数一数涂色小份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at how 5 becomes 10, then multiply 2 by the same number.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看 5 怎样变成 10，再把 2 乘同一个数。

prompt.en: Fill in the missing bottom number: {1/4} = {3/?}.

guide.en: The arrow marks {1/4} of the way from 0 to 1. The top changes from 1 to 3 by multiplying by 3, so multiply the bottom by 3 to keep the same position.
guide.zh: 箭头在从 0 到 1 的 {1/4} 处。分子从 1 变成 3，是乘 3；分母也乘 3，位置才不变。

hints.en: Compare the top numbers, 1 and 3.
hints.zh: 比较分子 1 和 3。

hints.en: 1 × 3 = 3, so multiply 4 by 3 too.
The missing bottom number is 4 × 3.
hints.zh: 缺少的分母是 4 × 3。

correct.en: Yes. {1/4} = {3/12}: both numbers are multiplied by 3, so the point stays in the same place.
correct.zh: 对。{1/4} = {3/12}：分子和分母都乘 3，数轴上的位置不变。

say.en: Adding 2 to both numbers gives {3/6}, halfway along the line. Look for the multiplier that keeps the quarter's position.
say.zh: 分子分母都加 2 得到 {3/6}，到了数轴的中点。看看该乘几才能保持四分之一的位置。

say.en: Keeping 4 on the bottom gives {3/4}, farther along the line. Look at the top's ×3 and use it on the bottom too.
say.zh: 分母仍写 4 就得到 {3/4}，在数轴上更靠右。看看分子的 ×3，分母也要乘 3。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at how 1 becomes 3, then change 4 using the same multiplier.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看 1 怎样变成 3，再把 4 乘同一个数。

prompt.en: Fill in both boxes: {2/3} = {?/6} = {6/?}.

guide.en: Use {2/3} as the starting fraction for each box. For sixths, multiply both numbers by 2; for a top number of 6, multiply both by 3.
guide.zh: 两个空格都从 {2/3} 开始想。分母变成 6，分子分母都乘 2；分子变成 6，分子分母都乘 3。

hints.en: Look at the printed bottom number in the first box and top number in the second.
hints.zh: 看看第一空的分母和第二空的分子。

hints.en: Find 3 × ? = 6 for the first box and 2 × ? = 6 for the second.
hints.zh: 第一空想 3 × 几 = 6，第二空想 2 × 几 = 6。

hints.en: The first missing number is 2 × 2; the second is 3 × 3.
hints.zh: 第一空是 2 × 2，第二空是 3 × 3。

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} = {4/6} = {6/9}: multiply both numbers by 2 or both by 3 to keep the same amount.

say.en: Adding 3 to both numbers gives {5/6} and changes the amount. Look at 3 × 2 = 6 and multiply the top by 2 too.
say.zh: 分子分母都加 3 得到 {5/6}，多少变了。看看 3 × 2 = 6，分子也乘 2。

say.en: Keeping 2 on top gives {2/6}, changing only the bottom. Look at 3 × 2 = 6 and multiply the top by 2 too.
say.zh: 分子仍写 2 得到 {2/6}，只改了分母。看看 3 × 2 = 6，分子也要乘 2。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from {2/3} for each box and multiply the top and the bottom by the same number.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每一空都从 {2/3} 想起，分子和分母乘同一个数。

reveal.en: Multiply {2/3} by 2 on top and bottom to get {4/6}, and by 3 to get {6/9}. Fill in 4 and 9.
reveal.zh: {2/3} 的分子分母都乘 2 得到 {4/6}，都乘 3 得到 {6/9}。依次填 4 和 9。

prompt.en: Which fraction equals {1/6}?
prompt.zh: 哪个分数等于 {1/6}？

guide.en: Look at the shaded sixth of the circle. Cutting every sixth into 2 makes twelfths, and the shaded sixth becomes 2 small parts too.
guide.zh: 看看圆上涂色的六分之一。每个六分之一分成 2 小份，就变成十二分之几，涂色的那份也变成 2 小份。

hints.en: Compare the bottom number 6 with the options' bottom number 12.
hints.zh: 比较原来的分母 6 和选项的分母 12。

hints.en: Multiply both the top and the bottom by 2.
hints.zh: 分子和分母都乘 2。

hints.en: Look for 1 × 2 shaded parts out of 6 × 2 parts.
hints.zh: 找出总份数为 6 × 2、涂色份数为 1 × 2 的分数。

correct.en: Yes. {1/6} = {2/12}: both numbers are multiplied by 2, so the shaded amount stays the same.
correct.zh: 对。{1/6} = {2/12}：分子和分母都乘 2，涂色的多少不变。

say.en: {1/12} changes only the bottom number and is half as much. Look at how the shaded sixth splits into 2 pieces too.
