say.zh: {1/12} 只改了分母，只有原来的一半。看看涂色的六分之一也分成了 2 小份。

say.en: {7/12} adds 6 to both numbers and is more than half. Look at the shaded sixth and use ×2 on both numbers.
say.zh: {7/12} 是分子分母都加 6，已经超过一半。看看涂色的六分之一，分子分母都要乘 2。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the fraction made by multiplying both numbers of {1/6} by 2.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找出把 {1/6} 的分子分母都乘 2 得到的分数。

reveal.en: Choose {2/12}: 1 × 2 = 2 and 6 × 2 = 12, so it names the same amount as {1/6}.

prompt.en: Shade {2/3} of the circle, which has 9 equal parts.
prompt.zh: 圆已平均分成 9 份，涂出它的 {2/3}。

guide.en: The circle is cut into ninths, so each third contains 3 small parts. To shade two thirds, multiply both numbers of {2/3} by 3.
guide.zh: 圆分成了九等份，每个三分之一有 3 小份。要涂出三分之二，把 {2/3} 的分子和分母都乘 3。

hints.en: Look at how many of the 9 parts make one third of the circle.
hints.zh: 看看 9 份中的几份合起来是圆的三分之一。

hints.en: 3 × 3 = 9, so multiply the 2 shaded thirds by 3 too.
hints.zh: 3 × 3 = 9，所以涂色的 2 个三分之一也乘 3。

hints.en: Shade 2 × 3 = 6 of the 9 parts.
hints.zh: 涂出 9 份中的 2 × 3 = 6 份。

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} = {6/9}: each third is 3 ninths, so two thirds are 6 ninths.
correct.zh: 对。{2/3} = {6/9}：每个三分之一是 3 个九分之一，两个就是 6 个。

say.en: Shading 2 small parts gives {2/9}. Look at each third: it contains 3 of these smaller parts.
say.zh: 只涂 2 小份是 {2/9}。看看每个三分之一，它包含 3 个这样的小份。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find 3 small parts for each third, then shade two such groups.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每 3 小份是一组三分之一，涂出这样的两组。

reveal.en: Shade 6 of the 9 parts. Multiplying the top and the bottom by 3 gives {2/3} = {6/9}.
reveal.zh: 涂出 9 份中的 6 份。分子和分母都乘 3，得到 {2/3} = {6/9}。

caption.en: {6/8} of a strip is shaded.
caption.zh: 纸条涂了 {6/8}。

caption.en: Join the parts in twos: 8 parts become 4 and 6 shaded parts become 3. The amount stays the same.
caption.zh: 每 2 份合成 1 份：8 份变成 4 份，涂色的 6 份变成 3 份。涂色的多少不变。

caption.en: Quarters cannot be joined evenly again: no number except 1 divides both 3 and 4. {3/4} is in its simplest form.
caption.zh: 四分之几不能再平均合并了：除了 1，没有别的数能同时整除 3 和 4。{3/4} 是最简分数。

caption.en: From {4/12}, joining in twos gives {2/6}, which can still be joined. Joining in fours goes straight to {1/3}.
caption.zh: 从 {4/12} 开始，每 2 份合成 1 份得到 {2/6}，还能再合；每 4 份合成 1 份，直接得到 {1/3}。

keyFacts.en: Divide the numerator and the denominator by the same number.
keyFacts.zh: 分子和分母同时除以同一个数。

keyFacts.en: Simplest form: no number except 1 divides both.
keyFacts.zh: 最简分数：除了 1，没有数能同时整除分子和分母。

prompt.en: Join the parts to write {6/8} with fewer, bigger parts.
prompt.zh: 把小份合起来，用更少、更大的份写出 {6/8}。

guide.en: Joining equal groups of parts is the opposite of cutting: the top and the bottom are both divided by the same number. You can only join in groups that come out evenly.
guide.zh: 把相等的几份合成一份，和切开正好相反：分子和分母都除以同一个数。只有能刚好分成组的时候才能合。

hints.en: In which groups can you join both the 8 parts and the 6 shaded parts?
hints.zh: 8 份和涂色的 6 份，都能几份几份地合起来？

hints.en: Try joining in twos.
hints.zh: 试试两份合成一份。

correct.en: Yes. {6/8} = {3/4}. Joining in twos divides both numbers by 2, and quarters cannot be joined evenly again.
correct.zh: 对。{6/8} = {3/4}。两份合成一份，分子和分母都除以 2；四分之几不能再平均合并了。

fallback.en: Not yet. Join in groups that both 8 and 6 can be split into.
fallback.zh: 还没对。要按 8 和 6 都能平均分成的组来合。

reveal.en: Join in twos: 8 parts become 4 and the 6 shaded parts become 3: {3/4}.
reveal.zh: 两份合成一份：8 份变成 4 份，涂色的 6 份变成 3 份：{3/4}。

prompt.en: Write {4/12} in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 把 {4/12} 化成最简分数。

guide.en: Divide the top and the bottom by the same number. Keep going until no number except 1 divides both of them.
guide.zh: 分子和分母同时除以同一个数，一直除到除了 1 以外，没有数能同时整除它们。

hints.en: Which number divides both 4 and 12?
hints.zh: 哪个数能同时整除 4 和 12？

hints.en: Try 4.
hints.zh: 试试 4。

correct.en: Yes. {4/12} = {1/3}. Only 1 divides both 1 and 3, so it is in simplest form.
correct.zh: 对。{4/12} = {1/3}。1 和 3 只能同时被 1 整除，所以这是最简分数。

say.en: Equal, yes. Can the parts be joined again? 2 and 6 can both be divided by 2.
say.zh: 是相等的。还能再合吗？2 和 6 都能被 2 整除。

say.en: Divide the top and the bottom by the same number, not just one of them.
say.zh: 分子和分母要除以同一个数，不能只除其中一个。

fallback.en: Not yet. Divide the top and the bottom by the same number.
fallback.zh: 还没对。分子和分母要除以同一个数。

reveal.en: Divide both by 4: {4/12} = {1/3}.

prompt.en: Which fraction is already in its simplest form?
prompt.zh: 哪个分数已经是最简分数？

guide.en: A fraction is in simplest form when no number except 1 divides both its top and its bottom.
guide.zh: 如果除了 1 以外，没有数能同时整除分子和分母，这个分数就是最简分数。

hints.en: For each fraction, look for a number that divides both of its numbers.
hints.zh: 每个分数都找一找：有没有一个数能同时整除分子和分母？

hints.en: 3 and 9, 6 and 10, 4 and 6 can each be divided by the same number.
hints.zh: 3 和 9、6 和 10、4 和 6，都能被同一个数整除。

correct.en: Yes. Only 1 divides both 5 and 8, so {5/8} cannot be made simpler.
correct.zh: 对。5 和 8 只能同时被 1 整除，{5/8} 不能再化简了。

say.en: That one can still be made simpler: its top and bottom can both be divided by the same number.
say.zh: 那个还能化简：它的分子和分母还能被同一个数整除。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the fraction where only 1 divides both numbers.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找一个只有 1 能同时整除分子和分母的分数。

prompt.en: Join the parts, then write {4/8} in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 合并小份，再把 {4/8} 写成最简分数。

guide.en: Look at all 8 parts and the 4 shaded parts. Join in groups that divide both counts evenly, then write the fraction with no further joining possible.
guide.zh: 看看全部的 8 份和涂色的 4 份。每组的份数要能同时整除这两个数，合到不能再平均合并，再写出分数。

hints.en: Which group sizes work for both 4 and 8?
hints.zh: 每组几份，才能把 4 份和 8 份都刚好分完？

hints.en: Joining in twos gives {2/4}, which can still be simplified. Try groups of 4.
hints.zh: 两份合成一份得到 {2/4}，还能化简。试试四份合成一份。

hints.en: 8 parts become 2, and the 4 shaded parts become 1.
hints.zh: 8 份变成 2 份，涂色的 4 份变成 1 份。

correct.en: Yes. {4/8} = {1/2}. Joining in fours divides both numbers by 4, and only 1 divides both 1 and 2.
correct.zh: 对。{4/8} = {1/2}。四份合成一份，分子和分母都除以 4；只有 1 能同时整除 1 和 2。

say.en: That is an equal fraction. Look at both numbers: 2 and 4 can still be divided by 2.
say.zh: 这是等值分数。再看看分子和分母：2 和 4 还能同时除以 2。

say.en: You divided only the top number. Look at the total parts too: divide both 4 and 8 by 4.
say.zh: 你只把分子除以 4。也看看总份数：4 和 8 都要除以 4。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for groups that divide both 4 and 8 evenly, and keep going to simplest form.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找能同时整除 4 和 8 的组，合到得到最简分数。

reveal.en: Join in fours: 8 parts become 2 and 4 shaded parts become 1. Write {1/2}; no number except 1 divides both numbers.
reveal.zh: 四份合成一份：8 份变成 2 份，涂色的 4 份变成 1 份。写出 {1/2}；除了 1，没有数能同时整除分子和分母。

prompt.en: Join the parts, then write {9/12} in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 合并小份，再把 {9/12} 写成最简分数。

guide.en: Your group size must divide both the 12 parts and the 9 shaded parts evenly. Divide both numbers by that size, then check that only 1 divides both new numbers.
guide.zh: 每组的份数要能同时整除全部的 12 份和涂色的 9 份。分子分母都除以这个数，再检查新的分子分母是否只能同时被 1 整除。

hints.en: Look for a group size that fits both 9 and 12.
hints.zh: 找一个能把 9 份和 12 份都刚好分完的组。

hints.en: Try joining in threes.
hints.zh: 试试三份合成一份。

hints.en: 12 ÷ 3 = 4 and 9 ÷ 3 = 3. Can 3 and 4 be divided together again?
hints.zh: 12 ÷ 3 = 4，9 ÷ 3 = 3。3 和 4 还能同时除以别的数吗？

correct.en: Yes. {9/12} = {3/4}. Both numbers were divided by 3, and only 1 divides both 3 and 4.
correct.zh: 对。{9/12} = {3/4}。分子分母都除以 3；只有 1 能同时整除 3 和 4。

say.en: That is an equal fraction. Look at 6 and 8: both can still be divided by 2.
say.zh: 这是等值分数。看看 6 和 8：它们还能同时除以 2。

say.en: You divided 9 by 3 but left 12 unchanged. Look at the total parts: divide 12 by 3 too.
say.zh: 你把 9 除以 3，却保留了 12。看看总份数：12 也要除以 3。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a number that divides both 9 and 12, then check the new fraction is simplest.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找能同时整除 9 和 12 的数，再检查得到的分数是否最简。

reveal.en: Join in threes: 12 parts become 4 and 9 shaded parts become 3. Write {3/4}; only 1 divides both numbers.
reveal.zh: 三份合成一份：12 份变成 4 份，涂色的 9 份变成 3 份。写出 {3/4}；只有 1 能同时整除分子和分母。

prompt.en: Write the shaded {6/12} in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 把涂色的 {6/12} 化成最简分数。

guide.en: Look at the 6 shaded parts out of 12 equal parts. Divide the top and the bottom by the same number until no number except 1 divides both.
guide.zh: 看看 12 等份中涂色的 6 份。分子分母同时除以同一个数，直到除了 1，没有数能同时整除它们。

hints.en: Which numbers divide both 6 and 12?
hints.zh: 哪些数能同时整除 6 和 12？

hints.en: Dividing by 2 gives {3/6}, which can still be simplified. Try dividing by 6.
hints.zh: 都除以 2 得到 {3/6}，还能化简。试试都除以 6。

correct.en: Yes. {6/12} = {1/2}. Dividing both numbers by 6 keeps the amount the same, and only 1 divides both 1 and 2.
correct.zh: 对。{6/12} = {1/2}。分子分母都除以 6，多少不变；只有 1 能同时整除 1 和 2。

say.en: Equal, yes. Look at 3 and 6: both can still be divided by 3.
say.zh: 是相等的。看看 3 和 6：它们还能同时除以 3。

say.en: You divided only 6 by 6. Look at the bottom number too: 12 must also be divided by 6.
say.zh: 你只把 6 除以 6。也看看分母：12 也要除以 6。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at both 6 and 12, and divide them by the same number until the fraction is simplest.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看 6 和 12，同时除以同一个数，直到得到最简分数。

reveal.en: Divide both numbers by 6: {6/12} = {1/2}. No number except 1 divides both 1 and 2.
reveal.zh: 分子分母都除以 6：{6/12} = {1/2}。除了 1，没有数能同时整除 1 和 2。

prompt.en: Write the marked {8/12} in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 把数轴上标出的 {8/12} 化成最简分数。

guide.en: The mark is 8 of the 12 equal intervals from 0. Divide both 8 and 12 by the same number to give this position its simplest fraction name.
guide.zh: 标记从 0 起经过了 12 个相等间隔中的 8 个。把 8 和 12 同时除以同一个数，用最简分数表示这个位置。

hints.en: Look for a number that divides both 8 and 12.
hints.zh: 找一个能同时整除 8 和 12 的数。

hints.en: Dividing both by 2 gives {4/6}. Can you simplify again, or divide by 4 straight away?
hints.zh: 都除以 2 得到 {4/6}。还能再化简吗？也可以直接都除以 4。

correct.en: Yes. {8/12} = {2/3}. The position stays the same, and only 1 divides both 2 and 3.
correct.zh: 对。{8/12} = {2/3}。数轴上的位置不变；只有 1 能同时整除 2 和 3。

say.en: That names the same position. Look at 4 and 6: both can still be divided by 2.
say.zh: 这表示同一个位置。看看 4 和 6：它们还能同时除以 2。

say.en: You divided 8 by 4 but kept 12. Look at both numbers: divide 12 by 4 too to keep the same position.
say.zh: 你把 8 除以 4，却保留了 12。看看分子分母：12 也要除以 4，位置才不变。

fallback.en: Not yet. Keep the same position by dividing both 8 and 12 by the same number, then check for simplest form.
fallback.zh: 还没对。8 和 12 要同时除以同一个数，位置才不变；再检查是否最简。

reveal.en: Divide both numbers by 4: {8/12} = {2/3}. Only 1 divides both 2 and 3, so this is simplest form.
reveal.zh: 分子分母都除以 4：{8/12} = {2/3}。只有 1 能同时整除 2 和 3，所以这是最简分数。

prompt.en: Write the shaded {4/10} in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 把涂色的 {4/10} 化成最简分数。

guide.en: Look at the 4 shaded parts and all 10 equal parts. Divide both counts by the same number, then check whether the new top and bottom can still be divided together.
guide.zh: 看看涂色的 4 份和全部的 10 等份。两个数同时除以同一个数，再检查新的分子分母还能不能同时被别的数整除。

hints.en: Which number divides both 4 and 10?
hints.zh: 哪个数能同时整除 4 和 10？

hints.en: Try dividing both numbers by 2.
hints.zh: 试试分子分母都除以 2。

correct.en: Yes. {4/10} = {2/5}. Both numbers were divided by 2, and only 1 divides both 2 and 5.
correct.zh: 对。{4/10} = {2/5}。分子分母都除以 2；只有 1 能同时整除 2 和 5。

say.en: That keeps the same amount. Look at 4 and 10: both can still be divided by 2.
say.zh: 这表示同样的多少。看看 4 和 10：它们还能同时除以 2。

say.en: You divided only 10 by 2. Look at the shaded parts too: 4 must also be divided by 2.
say.zh: 你只把 10 除以 2。也看看涂色的份数：4 也要除以 2。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a number that divides both 4 and 10, then check that the new fraction cannot be simplified again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找能同时整除 4 和 10 的数，再检查得到的分数是否不能继续化简。

reveal.en: Divide both numbers by 2: {4/10} = {2/5}. No number except 1 divides both 2 and 5.
reveal.zh: 分子分母都除以 2：{4/10} = {2/5}。除了 1，没有数能同时整除 2 和 5。

prompt.en: Which fraction is already in its simplest form?
prompt.zh: 哪个分数已经是最简分数？

guide.en: Look at the top and bottom of each fraction. Choose the one where no number except 1 divides both.
guide.zh: 看看每个分数的分子和分母。选出除了 1，没有数能同时整除分子分母的分数。

hints.en: For each option, can both numbers be divided by the same number greater than 1?
hints.zh: 逐个看看：分子分母能同时除以一个大于 1 的数吗？

hints.en: 2 and 8 share 2; 6 and 9 share 3; 8 and 10 share 2.
hints.zh: 2 和 8 都能被 2 整除；6 和 9 都能被 3 整除；8 和 10 都能被 2 整除。

hints.en: Check 7 and 10: does any number except 1 divide both?
hints.zh: 看看 7 和 10：除了 1，还有数能同时整除它们吗？

correct.en: Yes. {7/10} is in simplest form because only 1 divides both 7 and 10.
correct.zh: 对。{7/10} 是最简分数，因为只有 1 能同时整除 7 和 10。

say.en: That fraction can still be simplified. Look at its top and bottom for a number greater than 1 that divides both.
say.zh: 这个分数还能化简。看看它的分子分母，找一个大于 1、能同时整除它们的数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at both numbers in each option and find the fraction where only 1 divides both.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看各选项的分子分母，找出只有 1 能同时整除它们的分数。

reveal.en: Choose {7/10}. Only 1 divides both 7 and 10; the others simplify: {2/8} = {1/4}, {6/9} = {2/3}, {8/10} = {4/5}.

prompt.en: Choose the fraction that cannot be simplified further.
prompt.zh: 选出不能再化简的分数。

guide.en: Look for a number that divides both numbers of a fraction. It is already simplest if only 1 works for both, even when each number can be divided separately.
guide.zh: 找能同时整除分子和分母的数。即使分子和分母各自能被别的数整除，只要能同时整除它们的数只有 1，就是最简分数。

hints.en: Check both numbers together, not just the top or the bottom.
hints.zh: 把分子分母一起检查，不能只看其中一个。

hints.en: 4 and 8 can both be divided by 4; 9 and 12 by 3; 6 and 12 by 6.
hints.zh: 4 和 8 都能被 4 整除；9 和 12 都能被 3 整除；6 和 12 都能被 6 整除。

hints.en: 2 divides 4 but not 9; 3 divides 9 but not 4. Check {4/9}.
hints.zh: 2 能整除 4，不能整除 9；3 能整除 9，不能整除 4。看看 {4/9}。

correct.en: Yes. {4/9} is in simplest form: no number except 1 divides both 4 and 9.
correct.zh: 对。{4/9} 是最简分数：除了 1，没有数能同时整除 4 和 9。

say.en: That fraction can still be simplified. Look for a number greater than 1 that divides both its top and bottom.
say.zh: 这个分数还能化简。看看分子分母，找一个大于 1、能同时整除它们的数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for the option where no number except 1 divides both the top and the bottom.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看各选项，找出除了 1，没有数能同时整除分子分母的分数。

reveal.en: Choose {4/9}; only 1 divides both 4 and 9. The others simplify: {4/8} = {1/2}, {9/12} = {3/4}, {6/12} = {1/2}.

caption.en: {2/3} and {3/4}: the parts are different sizes, so counting parts does not tell which is greater.
caption.zh: {2/3} 和 {3/4}：两边每份大小不一样，只数份数比不出大小。

caption.en: Cut both strips into twelfths. Now the parts are the same size: {2/3} = {8/12} and {3/4} = {9/12}.
8 twelfths are fewer than 9 twelfths, so {2/3} < {3/4}. Both were one part short of a whole, but a third is a bigger gap than a quarter.
caption.zh: 8 个十二分之一比 9 个少，所以 {2/3} < {3/4}。两个都差一份到整体，可是差的三分之一比四分之一大。

caption.en: On a line cut into eighths, {1/2} is {4/8} and {3/4} is {6/8}. From the smallest: {3/8}, {1/2}, {3/4}.

keyFacts.en: Make the parts the same size first, then compare the numerators.
keyFacts.zh: 先把每份化成一样大，再比分子。

keyFacts.en: {2/3} and {3/4} are both one part short, but not the same.
keyFacts.zh: {2/3} 和 {3/4} 都差一份到整体，但并不相等。

prompt.en: Make same-size parts, then choose: {2/3} ○ {3/4}.
prompt.zh: 先化成同样大的份，再选：{2/3} ○ {3/4}。

guide.en: Thirds and quarters are different sizes, so count both in a size they can share. 3 and 4 both go into 12: {2/3} = {8/12} and {3/4} = {9/12}.
guide.zh: 三分之一和四分之一大小不同，要先换成两个都能用的同样大的份。3 和 4 都能变成 12：{2/3} = {8/12}，{3/4} = {9/12}。

hints.en: Press Make same-size parts.
hints.zh: 按「化成同样大的份」。

hints.en: Both bars are now in twelfths. Count the shaded twelfths.
hints.zh: 两条现在都是十二分之几。数一数涂了几个十二分之一。

hints.en: 8 twelfths and 9 twelfths.
hints.zh: 8 个十二分之一和 9 个十二分之一。

say.en: Each one is one part short of a whole, but a missing third is bigger than a missing quarter. Compare the same-size parts.
say.zh: 两个都差一份到一个整体，但缺的三分之一比缺的四分之一大。用同样大的份来比。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the shaded twelfths in the two bars.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比一比两条里涂了几个十二分之一。

guide.en: 6 and 12 are related: each sixth is 2 twelfths. Rename only the sixths: {5/6} = {10/12}.
guide.zh: 6 和 12 成倍数：每个六分之一是 2 个十二分之一。只要把六分之几换成十二分之几：{5/6} = {10/12}。

hints.en: How many twelfths make one sixth?
hints.zh: 几个十二分之一是一个六分之一？

say.en: 7 is more than 5, but twelfths are smaller than sixths. Make the parts the same size first.
say.zh: 7 比 5 大，但十二分之一比六分之一小。先化成同样大的份再比。

fallback.en: Not yet. Rename the sixths as twelfths, then compare.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把六分之几换成十二分之几，再比。

prompt.en: Order from smallest to greatest: {1/2}, {3/8}, {3/4}.

guide.en: Write them all in eighths: {1/2} = {4/8} and {3/4} = {6/8}. Then compare the numbers of eighths.
guide.zh: 都化成八分之几：{1/2} = {4/8}，{3/4} = {6/8}。再比一比各有几个八分之一。

hints.en: How many eighths make {1/2}? How many make {3/4}?
hints.zh: {1/2} 是几个八分之一？{3/4} 呢？

hints.en: 3, 4 and 6 eighths.
hints.zh: 3 个、4 个和 6 个八分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {3/8} < {1/2} < {3/4}: 3, 4 and 6 eighths. The points on the line show it.
correct.zh: 对。{3/8} < {1/2} < {3/4}：3 个、4 个、6 个八分之一。数轴上的点也是这样排的。

say.en: That orders the top numbers only. The parts are different sizes: write them all in eighths first.
say.zh: 这是只比了分子。几个分数的份大小不同，先都化成八分之几。

fallback.en: Not yet. Write each fraction in eighths, then order them.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把每个分数写成八分之几，再排。

prompt.en: Make same-size parts, then choose: {1/2} ○ {3/8}.
prompt.zh: 先化成同样大的份，再选：{1/2} ○ {3/8}。

guide.en: The two chocolate bars are the same size. Cut each half into 4 equal parts: {1/2} = {4/8}. Now compare the numbers of eighths.
guide.zh: 两条巧克力一样大。把每个二分之一再平均分成 4 份：{1/2} = {4/8}。再比各有几个八分之一。

hints.en: Both bars are the same length, so they show the same whole.
hints.zh: 两条一样长，表示同样大的整体。

hints.en: Press Make same-size parts to turn the half into eighths.
hints.zh: 按「化成同样大的份」，把二分之一化成八分之几。

hints.en: Compare 4 eighths with 3 eighths.
hints.zh: 比较 4 个八分之一和 3 个八分之一。

say.en: 3 is more than 1, but an eighth is smaller than a half. Make both bars show eighths before you count.
say.zh: 3 比 1 大，但八分之一比二分之一小。先把两条都化成八分之几，再数份数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the shaded parts after both bars are cut into eighths.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看两条都分成八分之几后各涂了几份。

reveal.en: The half becomes {4/8}. Since {4/8} > {3/8}, choose >.

prompt.en: Make same-size parts, then pick the greater fraction: {2/3} or {3/6}.
prompt.zh: 先化成同样大的份，再选较大的：{2/3} 或 {3/6}。

guide.en: Each third is 2 sixths. Rename {2/3} as {4/6}, then compare it with {3/6}.
guide.zh: 每个三分之一是 2 个六分之一。把 {2/3} 化成 {4/6}，再和 {3/6} 比。

hints.en: Look at the sizes of the thirds and sixths.
hints.zh: 看看三分之一和六分之一各有多大。

hints.en: Press Make same-size parts. Split each third into 2 equal parts.
hints.zh: 按「化成同样大的份」，把每个三分之一再平均分成 2 份。

hints.en: Which is more: 4 sixths or 3 sixths?
hints.zh: 4 个六分之一和 3 个六分之一，哪个多？

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} = {4/6}, which is greater than {3/6}.

say.en: The top number 3 is bigger than 2, but sixths are smaller than thirds. Compare the shaded sixths after splitting.
say.zh: 分子 3 比 2 大，但六分之一比三分之一小。分好后，比一比涂色的六分之一有几个。

fallback.en: Not yet. Rename the thirds as sixths and look at which shaded bar reaches further.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把三分之几化成六分之几，看哪条的涂色部分更长。

prompt.en: Make same-size parts, then choose: {3/4} ○ {5/6}.
prompt.zh: 先化成同样大的份，再选：{3/4} ○ {5/6}。

guide.en: 4 and 6 both go into 12. Rename {3/4} as {9/12} and {5/6} as {10/12}. Compare these same-size parts.

hints.en: Look at the unshaded part in each bar: are those parts the same size?
hints.zh: 看看两条各缺的一份：它们一样大吗？

hints.en: Press Make same-size parts to cut both bars into twelfths.
hints.zh: 按「化成同样大的份」，把两条都分成十二分之几。

hints.en: Compare 9 twelfths with 10 twelfths.
hints.zh: 比较 9 个十二分之一和 10 个十二分之一。

say.en: Both are one part short of a whole, but the missing quarter is bigger than the missing sixth. Look at the shaded twelfths.
say.zh: 两个都差一份到整体，但缺的四分之一比缺的六分之一大。看看各涂了几个十二分之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Cut both bars into twelfths and compare the shaded parts.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把两条都分成十二分之几，再比涂色的份数。

prompt.en: Pick the smaller fraction: {2/3} or {2/4}.

guide.en: The wall rows all show the same whole. Rename {2/3} as {8/12} and {2/4} as {6/12}. Compare the numbers of twelfths.
guide.zh: 分数墙的每行都表示同样大的整体。{2/3} = {8/12}，{2/4} = {6/12}。再比各有几个十二分之一。

hints.en: Look at where the two shaded rows end.
hints.zh: 看看两行的涂色部分各到哪里。

hints.en: Use the twelfths row: each third is 4 twelfths and each quarter is 3 twelfths.
hints.zh: 看十二等份那行：每个三分之一是 4 个十二分之一，每个四分之一是 3 个。

hints.en: Which is fewer: 8 twelfths or 6 twelfths?
hints.zh: 8 个十二分之一和 6 个十二分之一，哪个少？

correct.en: Yes. {2/4} = {6/12}, which is smaller than {2/3} = {8/12}.

say.en: A bigger denominator makes each part smaller in the same whole. Look at the wall: 2 quarters cover fewer twelfths than 2 thirds.
say.zh: 同一个整体分得越多，每份越小。看分数墙：2 个四分之一占的十二分之一，比 2 个三分之一少。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use the twelfths row to compare the two shaded lengths.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用十二等份那行比较两行的涂色长度。

prompt.en: Make same-size parts, then choose: {1/2} ○ {4/8}.
prompt.zh: 先化成同样大的份，再选：{1/2} ○ {4/8}。

guide.en: The ribbon strips are the same length. Split each half into 4 equal parts, so {1/2} becomes {4/8}. Compare the shaded eighths.
guide.zh: 两条丝带一样长。把每个二分之一再平均分成 4 份，{1/2} 就化成 {4/8}。再比涂色的八分之一有几个。

hints.en: Look at where each shaded strip ends.
hints.zh: 看看两条的涂色部分各到哪里。

hints.en: Press Make same-size parts to rename the half as eighths.
hints.zh: 按「化成同样大的份」，把二分之一化成八分之几。

hints.en: Both strips have 4 shaded eighths.
hints.zh: 两条都涂了 4 个八分之一。

correct.en: Yes. Both show 4 eighths, so {1/2} = {4/8}. They are equivalent fractions.
correct.zh: 对。两条都是 4 个八分之一，所以 {1/2} = {4/8}，是等值分数。

say.en: 4 is more than 1, but eighths are smaller than halves. Split the half into eighths and compare the shaded lengths.
say.zh: 4 比 1 大，但八分之一比二分之一小。把二分之一分成八分之几，再比涂色长度。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the shaded eighths in each strip after splitting.
fallback.zh: 还没对。分好后，数一数两条各涂了几个八分之一。

reveal.en: Splitting the half gives {4/8}, just like the other strip. Choose =.
reveal.zh: 把二分之一分成八分之几，得到 {4/8}，和另一条一样。选 =。

prompt.en: Order from smallest to greatest: {5/12}, {2/3}, {1/2}.

guide.en: Write all three fractions in twelfths: {2/3} = {8/12} and {1/2} = {6/12}. Order their numerators from smallest to greatest.
guide.zh: 把三个分数都写成十二分之几：{2/3} = {8/12}，{1/2} = {6/12}。再把分子从小到大排列。

hints.en: The number line has 12 equal intervals between 0 and 1.
hints.zh: 数轴上 0 到 1 之间平均分成了 12 段。

hints.en: Rename the thirds and the half as twelfths.
hints.zh: 把三分之几和二分之一都化成十二分之几。

hints.en: Use 5, 8 and 6 twelfths. The smallest is 5 twelfths.
hints.zh: 分别是 5 个、8 个、6 个十二分之一。最小的是 5 个十二分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {5/12} < {1/2} < {2/3}: 5, 6 and 8 twelfths, from left to right.

say.en: That orders only the top numbers 1, 2 and 5. The parts differ in size; rename them as twelfths before ordering.
say.zh: 这是只把分子 1、2、5 排了序。每份大小不同，要先都化成十二分之几再排。

fallback.en: Not yet. Write all three in twelfths and order their positions from left to right.
fallback.zh: 还没对。都化成十二分之几，再按数轴上从左到右的顺序排列。

prompt.en: Order from greatest to smallest: {1/3}, {1/2}, {1/6}.

guide.en: Use sixths for all three: {1/3} = {2/6} and {1/2} = {3/6}. Order the numbers of sixths from greatest to smallest.
guide.zh: 都化成六分之几：{1/3} = {2/6}，{1/2} = {3/6}。再把六分之一的个数从多到少排列。

hints.en: Look at the equal lengths of the wall rows and the sizes of their parts.
hints.zh: 看看分数墙：每行一样长，但每份大小不同。

hints.en: Use the sixths row to rename the third and the half.
hints.zh: 用六等份那行，把三分之一和二分之一都化成六分之几。

hints.en: You have 2, 3 and 1 sixths. Start with 3 sixths.
hints.zh: 分别是 2 个、3 个、1 个六分之一。先排 3 个六分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {1/2} > {1/3} > {1/6}, because 3 sixths > 2 sixths > 1 sixth.
correct.zh: 对。{1/2} > {1/3} > {1/6}，因为 3 个六分之一 > 2 个六分之一 > 1 个六分之一。

say.en: That orders the denominators 6, 3 and 2. More parts in the same whole make each part smaller; compare the amounts in sixths.
say.zh: 这是把分母 6、3、2 排了序。同一个整体分得越多，每份越小；先化成六分之几再比。

fallback.en: Not yet. Rename all three as sixths, then start with the greatest number of sixths.
fallback.zh: 还没对。都化成六分之几，再从六分之一最多的开始排。

caption.en: {1/2} + {1/4}: halves and quarters are different sizes, so they cannot be counted together yet.
caption.zh: {1/2} + {1/4}：二分之一和四分之一大小不同，还不能直接合起来数。

caption.en: Turn the half into quarters first: cut each part into 2, and {1/2} = {2/4}.
caption.zh: 先把二分之一化成四分之几：每份分成 2 份，{1/2} = {2/4}。

caption.en: Now both are quarters. Add one more quarter: 2 quarters and 1 quarter make 3 quarters.
caption.zh: 现在都是四分之几了。再加 1 个四分之一：2 个四分之一加 1 个四分之一是 3 个四分之一。

caption.en: A word problem drawn as a model: a bow of {3/10} and a bookmark of {2/5} from one ribbon. {2/5} = {4/10}, so together {7/10}.
caption.zh: 用模型图表示应用题：一条丝带，{3/10} 做蝴蝶结，{2/5} 做书签。{2/5} = {4/10}，所以一共 {7/10}。

keyFacts.en: Turn the bigger parts into the smaller ones first.
keyFacts.zh: 先把大的份化成小的份。

keyFacts.en: Then add the numerators; the denominator stays.
keyFacts.zh: 再把分子相加，分母不变。

prompt.en: Turn the half into quarters, add {1/4}, then write {1/2} + {1/4}.
prompt.zh: 把一半化成四分之几，加上 {1/4}，再写出 {1/2} + {1/4}。

guide.en: Halves and quarters are different sizes, so you cannot count them together yet. Cut the half into 2 quarters: {1/2} = {2/4}. Now add quarters to quarters.
guide.zh: 二分之一和四分之一大小不同，还不能直接合起来数。把一半切成 2 个四分之一：{1/2} = {2/4}。再把四分之几加起来。

hints.en: Cut each half into 2 parts.
hints.zh: 把每个一半切成 2 份。

hints.en: Shade 1 more quarter.
hints.zh: 再涂 1 个四分之一。

say.en: Halves and quarters cannot be added top and bottom. Turn the half into quarters first: {1/2} = {2/4}.
say.zh: 二分之一和四分之一不能把分子、分母分别相加。先把一半化成四分之几：{1/2} = {2/4}。

say.en: Halves and quarters are different sizes. Turn the half into quarters first, then count the quarters.
say.zh: 二分之一和四分之一大小不同。先把一半化成四分之几，再数四分之几。

fallback.en: Not yet. Make the parts the same size first, then count the quarters.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先化成同样大的份，再数四分之几。

reveal.en: {1/2} is {2/4}; one more quarter makes {3/4}.

prompt.en: Add {1/3} + {5/12}. Give the answer in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 计算 {1/3} + {5/12}，答案化成最简分数。

guide.en: Each third is 4 twelfths, so {1/3} = {4/12}. Add the twelfths, then join parts if you can.
guide.zh: 每个三分之一是 4 个十二分之一，所以 {1/3} = {4/12}。把十二分之几加起来，能合就再合。

hints.en: Cut each third into 4.
hints.zh: 把每个三分之一切成 4 份。

hints.en: 9 and 12 can both be divided by 3.
hints.zh: 9 和 12 都能被 3 整除。

say.en: Equal, yes: {9/12} is right. Can you join the parts again? 9 and 12 can both be divided by 3.
say.zh: 是相等的：{9/12} 没错。还能再合吗？9 和 12 都能被 3 整除。

say.en: Thirds and twelfths cannot be added top and bottom. Turn the third into twelfths first.
say.zh: 三分之一和十二分之一不能把分子、分母分别相加。先把三分之一化成十二分之几。

say.en: Thirds and twelfths are different sizes. Each third is 4 twelfths, so {1/3} = {4/12} first.
say.zh: 三分之一和十二分之一大小不同。每个三分之一是 4 个十二分之一，先写成 {1/3} = {4/12}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Rename the third as twelfths, add, then simplify.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把三分之一化成十二分之几，相加，再化简。

prompt.en: Aisha used {3/10} of a ribbon for a bow and {2/5} for a bookmark. How much altogether?
prompt.zh: Aisha 用丝带的 {3/10} 打蝴蝶结，{2/5} 做书签。她一共用了几分之几？

guide.en: The whole bar is the ribbon. {2/5} is the same as {4/10}, so both pieces can be counted in tenths. Add the tenths.
guide.zh: 整条是这条丝带。{2/5} 等于 {4/10}，两段就都能用十分之几来数，再把十分之几加起来。

hints.en: Press Split into tenths.
hints.zh: 按「分成十分之几」。

say.en: Tenths and fifths cannot be added top and bottom. Turn {2/5} into tenths first.
say.zh: 十分之几和五分之几不能把分子、分母分别相加。先把 {2/5} 化成十分之几。

say.en: Fifths are bigger than tenths. {2/5} is 4 tenths, not 2.
say.zh: 五分之一比十分之一大。{2/5} 是 4 个十分之一，不是 2 个。

fallback.en: Not yet. Write both pieces in tenths, then add.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把两段都写成十分之几，再相加。

reveal.en: The bookmark piece is {4/10}, so the two pieces are {7/10} of the ribbon.
reveal.zh: 书签那段是 {4/10}，两段合起来是丝带的 {7/10}。

prompt.en: Turn thirds into ninths, add {1/9}, then write {2/3} + {1/9}.
prompt.zh: 把三分之几化成九分之几，加上 {1/9}，再写出 {2/3} + {1/9}。

guide.en: The chocolate bar is one whole with 2 thirds given. Cut each third into 3 equal parts: {2/3} = {6/9}. Add one more ninth.
guide.zh: 整条巧克力是一个整体，已给出三分之二。把每个三分之一平均分成 3 份：{2/3} = {6/9}。再加一个九分之一。

hints.en: Look at the size of a third and a ninth.
hints.zh: 看看三分之一和九分之一的大小。

hints.en: Cut each third into 3 equal parts.
hints.zh: 把每个三分之一平均分成 3 份。

hints.en: You have {6/9}; shade 1 more ninth.
hints.zh: 已有 {6/9}，再涂 1 个九分之一。

say.en: A third is bigger than a ninth. Look at the given parts: {2/3} is 6 ninths, not 2.
say.zh: 三分之一比九分之一大。看看已给出的部分：{2/3} 是 6 个九分之一，不是 2 个。

say.en: Adding the denominators changes the part size. Cut the thirds into ninths first, then keep the denominator 9.
say.zh: 把分母相加会改变每份的大小。先把三分之几化成九分之几，再相加，分母仍是 9。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the given thirds, rename them as ninths, then count all the marked ninths.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看已给出的三分之几，先化成九分之几，再数所有已标出的份。

reveal.en: Each of the 2 thirds becomes 3 ninths. The 6 given ninths and 1 more ninth make {7/9}.
reveal.zh: 2 个三分之一各分成 3 个九分之一。已有的 6 份再加 1 份，得到 {7/9}。

prompt.en: Turn the quarter into eighths, add {5/8}, then write {1/4} + {5/8}.
prompt.zh: 把四分之一化成八分之几，加上 {5/8}，再写出 {1/4} + {5/8}。

guide.en: The strip shows one quarter given. Cut each quarter into 2 equal parts, so {1/4} = {2/8}. Then add 5 eighths.
guide.zh: 纸条已给出四分之一。把每个四分之一平均分成 2 份，{1/4} = {2/8}。再加 5 个八分之一。

hints.en: Look at the quarter already marked.
hints.zh: 看看已标出的四分之一。

hints.en: Cut each quarter into 2 eighths.
hints.zh: 把每个四分之一切成 2 个八分之一。

hints.en: Add 5 eighths to the 2 given eighths.
hints.zh: 在已有的 2 个八分之一上，再加 5 个八分之一。

say.en: Quarters and eighths are different sizes. Look at the strip and rename the quarter as {2/8}; the denominator stays 8 when you add.
say.zh: 四分之一和八分之一大小不同。看看纸条，把四分之一化成 {2/8}，相加时分母仍是 8。

say.en: The given quarter is 2 eighths, not 1. Count its two smaller parts before adding the 5 eighths.
say.zh: 已给出的四分之一是 2 个八分之一，不是 1 个。先数出它的两小份，再加 5 个八分之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Split the quarters into eighths, then count the given parts and the parts you added.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把四分之几化成八分之几，再数已有的份和新加的份。

reveal.en: The given quarter becomes {2/8}. Add {5/8} to get {7/8}.
reveal.zh: 已给出的四分之一化成 {2/8}，加上 {5/8}，得到 {7/8}。

prompt.en: Add {1/6} + {1/2}. Write the answer in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 计算 {1/6} + {1/2}，答案写成最简分数。

guide.en: The circle is cut into sixths, with one sixth given. Rename the half as {3/6}, then add the sixths. Join equal groups of parts to give the simplest form.
guide.zh: 圆已平均分成 6 份，并给出六分之一。把一半化成 {3/6}，再把六分之几相加。最后把份合并，写成最简分数。

hints.en: Look at how many sixths cover half the circle.
hints.zh: 看看半个圆包含几个六分之一。

hints.en: The sum is {4/6}; divide both numbers by 2.
hints.zh: 和是 {4/6}，分子、分母都除以 2。

say.en: Equal, yes. {4/6} has the right value. Look for pairs of sixths: divide 4 and 6 by 2.
say.zh: 是相等的，{4/6} 的大小对了。看看能合并的两份：4 和 6 都除以 2。

say.en: A half covers 3 sixths, not 1. Look at half the circle before adding the numerators.
say.zh: 一半包含 3 个六分之一，不是 1 个。先看看半个圆，再把分子相加。

say.en: Adding 6 and 2 does not count equal parts. Rename the half as sixths and keep the denominator 6 when adding.
say.zh: 把 6 和 2 相加不是在数同样大的份。先把一半化成六分之几，相加时分母仍是 6。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count both amounts in sixths, add them, then see whether the parts can be joined.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把两个量都写成六分之几，相加后再看看能否合并。

reveal.en: A half is {3/6}. Add {1/6} to get {4/6}, then divide 4 and 6 by 2 to get {2/3}.

guide.en: Both strips show the same-sized whole. Each fifth is 2 tenths, so rename {1/5} as {2/10}. Add the tenths; an equivalent fraction is also accepted.
guide.zh: 两条纸条表示同样大的整体。每个五分之一是 2 个十分之一，先把 {1/5} 化成 {2/10}。再把十分之几相加，也可以写等值分数。

hints.en: Compare one fifth with the tenths below it.
hints.zh: 对照上面的五分之一和下面的十分之一。

hints.en: Rename {1/5} as {2/10}.
Count 2 tenths and 3 tenths together.
hints.zh: 把 2 个十分之一和 3 个十分之一合起来数。

say.en: The fifth covers 2 tenths, not 1. Look at where the fifth ends on the lower strip.
say.zh: 五分之一包含 2 个十分之一，不是 1 个。看看上面的五分之一对齐下面的哪一条分界线。

say.en: Adding the denominators changes the unit. Look at the strips: rename the fifth as tenths, then keep the denominator 10.
say.zh: 把分母相加会改变每份的大小。看看纸条，先把五分之一化成十分之几，相加时分母仍是 10。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use tenths for both amounts, then add their numerators.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把两个量都写成十分之几，再把分子相加。

reveal.en: One fifth is 2 tenths. Adding 3 tenths gives {5/10}, or {1/2}.
reveal.zh: 一个五分之一是 2 个十分之一，再加 3 个十分之一，得到 {5/10}，也就是 {1/2}。

prompt.en: Add {1/4} + {7/12}. Write the answer in twelfths.
prompt.zh: 计算 {1/4} + {7/12}，答案写成十二分之几。

guide.en: The line from 0 to 1 has 12 equal intervals. The quarter is 3 twelfths, so start at {3/12} and move 7 more intervals. Write the total in twelfths.
guide.zh: 数轴从 0 到 1 平均分成 12 个间隔。四分之一是 3 个十二分之一，从 {3/12} 再向右走 7 个间隔。把总数写成十二分之几。

hints.en: Look at the intervals from 0 to the quarter mark.
hints.zh: 看看从 0 到四分之一处有几个间隔。

hints.en: Rename {1/4} as {3/12}.
Add 7 twelfths to 3 twelfths; keep 12 below the fraction bar.
hints.zh: 3 个十二分之一再加 7 个十二分之一，分母仍写 12。

say.en: Adding 4 and 12 changes the interval size. Look at the line: every interval is one twelfth, so keep the denominator 12.
say.zh: 把 4 和 12 相加会改变间隔大小。看看数轴，每个间隔都是十二分之一，分母仍是 12。

say.en: A quarter is 3 intervals here, not 1. Count from 0 to the quarter mark before adding 7 twelfths.
say.zh: 这里的四分之一是 3 个间隔，不是 1 个。先数从 0 到四分之一处的间隔，再加 7 个十二分之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the quarter in twelfths, add 7 twelfths, and write the answer with denominator 12.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先用十二分之几表示四分之一，再加 7 个十二分之一，答案的分母写 12。

reveal.en: The quarter is {3/12}. Moving 7 more twelfths reaches {10/12}, so write {10/12}.
reveal.zh: 四分之一是 {3/12}，再走 7 个十二分之一，到达 {10/12}，所以写 {10/12}。

prompt.en: Ravi drinks {1/3} of a bottle, then {1/6} more. How much in all? Give simplest form.
prompt.zh: Ravi 喝了同一瓶水的 {1/3}，又喝了 {1/6}。共喝了几分之几？写最简分数。

guide.en: The whole bar is one bottle: Ravi drinks the first amount in the morning and the second in the afternoon. Rename {1/3} as {2/6} and add the sixths under the bracket. Then write the simplest form.
guide.zh: 整条表示一瓶水，前一段是上午喝的，后一段是下午喝的。把 {1/3} 化成 {2/6}，再把括号下的六分之几相加。最后写成最简分数。

hints.en: Look at the two pieces under the question-mark bracket.
hints.zh: 看看问号括号下的两段。

hints.en: Split into sixths: {1/3} = {2/6}.
The total is {3/6}; divide both numbers by 3.
hints.zh: 一共是 {3/6}，分子、分母都除以 3。

say.en: Equal, yes. {3/6} describes the total. Look at groups of 3 sixths and divide 3 and 6 by 3.
say.zh: 是相等的，{3/6} 表示这个总量。看看每 3 个六分之一合成一份，3 和 6 都除以 3。

say.en: The morning piece is 2 sixths, not 1. Split the model into sixths and count that piece again.
say.zh: 上午喝的那段是 2 个六分之一，不是 1 个。把模型图分成六分之几，再数这一段。

say.en: Thirds and sixths are different sizes. Look at the morning piece: rename it as sixths before adding, with denominator 6.
say.zh: 三分之一和六分之一大小不同。看看上午喝的那段，先化成六分之几再相加，分母仍是 6。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count both pieces in sixths, then simplify the fraction under the bracket.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先用六分之几数两段，再把括号下的分数化简。

reveal.en: The morning piece is {2/6} and the afternoon piece is {1/6}. Together they are {3/6}, or {1/2} of the bottle.
reveal.zh: 上午喝了 {2/6}，下午喝了 {1/6}。合起来是这瓶水的 {3/6}，也就是 {1/2}。

prompt.en: Siti uses {2/3} of a piece of fabric for a banner and {3/9} for flags. What fraction is used in all?
prompt.zh: Siti 用一块布的 {2/3} 做横幅，{3/9} 做小旗。共用了几分之几？

guide.en: The whole bar is one piece of fabric. Rename the banner piece as ninths: {2/3} = {6/9}. Add the ninths under the bracket and compare the total with one whole.
guide.zh: 整条表示一块布。把做横幅的那段化成九分之几：{2/3} = {6/9}。再把括号下的九分之几相加，看看是否满一个整体。

hints.en: Look at how much of the whole bar the bracket covers.
hints.zh: 看看括号盖住整条的多少。

hints.en: Split into ninths: {2/3} = {6/9}.
Add 6 ninths and 3 ninths; a whole has 9 ninths.
hints.zh: 把 6 个九分之一和 3 个九分之一相加；一个整体有 9 个九分之一。

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} + {3/9} = {6/9} + {3/9} = {9/9}, so all the fabric is used.

say.en: The banner piece covers 6 ninths, not 2. Split the bar into ninths and count that piece first.
say.zh: 做横幅的那段是 6 个九分之一，不是 2 个。把整条分成九分之几，先数这一段。

say.en: Adding 3 and 9 changes the part size. Rename the banner piece as ninths, then keep the denominator 9 when adding.
say.zh: 把 3 和 9 相加会改变每份的大小。先把做横幅的那段化成九分之几，相加时分母仍是 9。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count both pieces in ninths, then compare their total with the whole bar.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先用九分之几数两段，再把总量和整条比较。

reveal.en: The banner uses {6/9} and the flags use {3/9}. Their total is {9/9}, which is one whole piece of fabric.
reveal.zh: 横幅用了 {6/9}，小旗用了 {3/9}，合起来是 {9/9}，就是整块布。

caption.en: {7/8} − {1/2}: eighths and halves are different sizes.
caption.zh: {7/8} − {1/2}：八分之一和二分之一大小不同。

caption.en: Turn the half into eighths: {1/2} = {4/8}.
caption.zh: 把二分之一化成八分之几：{1/2} = {4/8}。

caption.en: Take 4 eighths away from 7 eighths: 3 eighths are left.
caption.zh: 从 7 个八分之一里拿走 4 个，还剩 3 个八分之一。

caption.en: Comparing two amounts is a subtraction too. Ravi drank {3/4} of a bottle and Wei Jie {5/8}: {6/8} − {5/8} = {1/8}.
caption.zh: 比较两个量也用减法。Ravi 喝了 {3/4} 瓶，Wei Jie 喝了 {5/8} 瓶：{6/8} − {5/8} = {1/8}。

keyFacts.en: Rename one fraction so both have the same denominator.
keyFacts.zh: 先把一个分数化成同分母。

keyFacts.en: Then take away the numerators; give the answer in simplest form when asked.
keyFacts.zh: 再把分子相减；题目要求时写成最简分数。

prompt.en: Take {1/2} away from {7/8}: cross out the right number of eighths.
prompt.zh: 从 {7/8} 里拿走 {1/2}：划掉相应的八分之几。

guide.en: A half is 4 eighths, so taking away {1/2} means crossing out 4 eighths. Then count the eighths that are left.
guide.zh: 一半是 4 个八分之一，拿走 {1/2} 就是划掉 4 个八分之一。再数一数剩下几个八分之一。

hints.en: How many eighths make one half?
hints.zh: 几个八分之一是一半？

hints.en: Cross out 4 parts.
hints.zh: 划掉 4 份。

say.en: A half is bigger than one eighth. Rename {1/2} as eighths first: it is 4 of them.
say.zh: 一半比一个八分之一大。先把 {1/2} 换成八分之几：是 4 个八分之一。

say.en: Eighths and halves cannot be taken away top and bottom. Rename the half as {4/8} first.
say.zh: 八分之几和二分之一不能把分子、分母分别相减。先把一半换成 {4/8}。

fallback.en: Not yet. A half of the strip is 4 eighths. Cross out 4, then count what is left.
fallback.zh: 还没对。纸条的一半是 4 个八分之一。划掉 4 份，再数剩下的。

reveal.en: Cross out 4 eighths: 3 eighths are left, {3/8}.
reveal.zh: 划掉 4 个八分之一，剩下 3 个八分之一：{3/8}。

prompt.en: A pandan cake has 12 equal slices. {5/12} is eaten. What fraction is left?
prompt.zh: 一个斑兰蛋糕平均切成 12 块，吃掉了 {5/12}，还剩几分之几？

guide.en: The whole cake is 1, and 1 is the same as {12/12}. Take away the {5/12} that was eaten.
guide.zh: 整个蛋糕是 1，1 等于 {12/12}。从中拿走吃掉的 {5/12}。

hints.en: 1 whole cake = {12/12}.

say.en: {7/5} compares the slices left with the slices eaten. The bottom number counts all 12 slices of the whole cake.
say.zh: {7/5} 是拿剩下的块数和吃掉的块数比。分母要数整个蛋糕的全部 12 块。

fallback.en: Not yet. Write the whole cake as twelfths, then take away the slices eaten.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把整个蛋糕写成十二分之几，再减去吃掉的块数。

reveal.en: 12 slices take away 5 leaves 7 of the 12: {7/12}.
reveal.zh: 12 块拿走 5 块，剩下 12 块中的 7 块：{7/12}。

prompt.en: From same-size bottles, Ravi drank {3/4} and Wei Jie {5/8}. How much more did Ravi drink?
prompt.zh: Ravi 喝了 {3/4} 瓶，Wei Jie 喝了 {5/8} 瓶。Ravi 多喝几分之几瓶？

guide.en: The bottles are the same size, so the two bars are the same length. The extra piece of Ravi's bar is the difference. {3/4} = {6/8}.
guide.zh: 两瓶水一样大，所以两条一样长。Ravi 那条多出来的一段就是相差的部分。{3/4} = {6/8}。

hints.en: Press Split into eighths and line the bars up.
hints.zh: 按「分成八分之几」，把两条对齐。

hints.en: {3/4} = {6/8}. How many eighths more?

fallback.en: Not yet. Rename {3/4} in eighths, then find the difference.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先把 {3/4} 换成八分之几，再求相差多少。

reveal.en: Ravi's bar is {6/8} and Wei Jie's is {5/8}: the extra piece is {1/8}.
reveal.zh: Ravi 那条是 {6/8}，Wei Jie 那条是 {5/8}：多出来的一段是 {1/8}。

prompt.en: Find {2/3} − {1/6}: split, cross out, then write the simplest answer.
prompt.zh: 计算 {2/3} − {1/6}：先细分、划掉，再写成最简分数。

guide.en: Split each third into 2 equal parts to make sixths. Cross out the sixth you take away, then count and simplify what remains.
guide.zh: 把每个三分之一平均分成 2 份，变成六分之几。划掉拿走的六分之一，再数剩下的份数，化成最简分数。

hints.en: Look at the given thirds and the sixth you need to take away.
hints.zh: 看看已有的三分之几和要拿走的六分之一。

hints.en: Split each third in two: {2/3} = {4/6}.
hints.zh: 把每个三分之一平均分成 2 份：{2/3} = {4/6}。

hints.en: Cross out 1 of the 4 sixths, then simplify the fraction left.
hints.zh: 从 4 个六分之一中划掉 1 个，再把剩下的分数化简。

say.en: Your answer treats the 2 thirds as 2 sixths. Look at the split strip: those 2 thirds make 4 sixths.
say.zh: 你把 2 个三分之一当成了 2 个六分之一。看看细分后的纸条：2 个三分之一变成了 4 个六分之一。

say.en: You have the right amount. Look at the 3 remaining sixths: join them into one half to write the simplest fraction.
say.zh: 你算出的量相等。看看剩下的 3 个六分之一：合起来是二分之一，再写成最简分数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the split strip: count the sixths given, take away 1 sixth, then simplify.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看细分后的纸条：数已有几个六分之一，拿走 1 个，再化简。

reveal.en: Split each third in two to get {4/6}. Cross out 1 sixth; {3/6} remains, which simplifies to {1/2}.
reveal.zh: 把每个三分之一平均分成 2 份，得到 {4/6}。划掉 1 个六分之一，剩下 {3/6}，化成最简分数是 {1/2}。

prompt.en: Find {3/4} − {1/12}: split, cross out, then write the simplest answer.
prompt.zh: 计算 {3/4} − {1/12}：先细分、划掉，再写成最简分数。

guide.en: Split each quarter of the chocolate bar into 3 equal parts. You can then take away 1 twelfth and simplify the amount left.
guide.zh: 把巧克力条的每个四分之一平均分成 3 份。再拿走 1 个十二分之一，把剩下的量写成最简分数。

hints.en: The quarters are larger than the twelfth you need to take away.
hints.zh: 四分之一比要拿走的十二分之一大。

hints.en: Split each quarter in three: {3/4} = {9/12}.
hints.zh: 把每个四分之一平均分成 3 份：{3/4} = {9/12}。

hints.en: Take 1 twelfth from 9 twelfths. Group the remaining twelfths in fours.
hints.zh: 从 9 个十二分之一中拿走 1 个。把剩下的十二分之一每 4 个合成一份。

say.en: Your answer counts the 3 quarters as 3 twelfths. Look at the split bar: each quarter makes 3 twelfths.
say.zh: 你把 3 个四分之一当成了 3 个十二分之一。看看细分后的条：每个四分之一变成了 3 个十二分之一。

say.en: You have the right amount. Look for groups of 4 twelfths, and divide both numerator and denominator by 4.
say.zh: 你算出的量相等。看看每 4 个十二分之一能合成一份，把分子、分母都除以 4。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the finer cuts: rename the quarters as twelfths before taking away, then simplify.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看细分后的份：先把四分之几化成十二分之几，再拿走，最后化简。

reveal.en: The 3 quarters become 9 twelfths. Cross out 1 twelfth: {8/12} remains, or {2/3} in simplest form.
reveal.zh: 3 个四分之一变成 9 个十二分之一。划掉 1 个十二分之一，剩下 {8/12}，化成最简分数是 {2/3}。

guide.en: Look at the 5 given eighths of the circle. Rename the quarter as eighths, then take it away.
guide.zh: 看看圆中已有的 5 个八分之一。先把四分之一化成八分之几，再拿走。

hints.en: How many eighths fit in one quarter of this circle?
hints.zh: 这个圆的四分之一包含几个八分之一？

hints.en: Use the equal parts: {1/4} = {2/8}.
Take 2 eighths from 5 eighths.
hints.zh: 从 5 个八分之一中拿走 2 个。

say.en: You subtracted both numerators and denominators. Look at the circle: rename the quarter, then count the eighths left; their size stays the same.
say.zh: 你把分子、分母分别相减了。看看圆：先把四分之一化成八分之几，再数剩下的八分之一；每份的大小不变。

say.en: You took away only 1 eighth. Look at the circle: the quarter covers 2 eighths, so take away 2.
say.zh: 你只拿走了 1 个八分之一。看看圆：四分之一占 2 个八分之一，要拿走 2 个。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the equal eighths in the circle and rename the quarter before subtracting.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看圆中同样大的八分之一，先把四分之一化成八分之几，再相减。

reveal.en: Rename {1/4} as {2/8}. Taking 2 eighths from 5 eighths leaves {3/8}.
reveal.zh: 把 {1/4} 化成 {2/8}。从 5 个八分之一中拿走 2 个，剩下 {3/8}。

prompt.en: Find {7/10} − {1/2}. Write the simplest fraction.

guide.en: Look at the distance between the two marks on the number line. Rename the half as tenths, count the gap in tenths, then simplify.
guide.zh: 看看数轴上两个标记之间的距离。把二分之一化成十分之几，数相差几个十分之一，再化成最简分数。

hints.en: Each interval is one tenth. Where is one half?
hints.zh: 每个间隔是十分之一。二分之一在哪里？

hints.en: A half is {5/10}; count from that mark to {7/10}.
hints.zh: 二分之一是 {5/10}；从这个标记数到 {7/10}。

hints.en: The gap is 2 tenths. Divide both numbers by 2 to simplify.
hints.zh: 相差 2 个十分之一。把分子、分母都除以 2，化成最简分数。

say.en: You subtracted both numerators and denominators. Look at the line: its intervals stay tenths; rename the half before counting the gap.
say.zh: 你把分子、分母分别相减了。看看数轴：每个间隔仍是十分之一；先把二分之一化成十分之几，再数相差多少。

say.en: You treated the half as 1 tenth. Look at the half mark: it is 5 tenths from zero.
say.zh: 你把二分之一当成了 1 个十分之一。看看二分之一的标记：它离零有 5 个十分之一。

say.en: You found the right gap. Look at the numerator and denominator: both can be divided by 2 to give the simplest fraction.
say.zh: 你找到了相差的量。看看分子和分母：它们都能除以 2，再写成最简分数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the two marks, rename the half as tenths, then count the gap and simplify.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看两个标记，把二分之一化成十分之几，再数相差多少并化简。

reveal.en: The marks are at {5/10} and {7/10}, so the gap is {2/10}. This simplifies to {1/5}.

prompt.en: Aisha: {5/6} m; Siti: {1/3} m. How much more? Give the simplest fraction.
prompt.zh: Aisha 有 {5/6} 米，Siti 有 {1/3} 米。相差几米？写最简分数。

guide.en: Both bars use 1 metre as the same whole to show the ribbon lengths. Find the extra piece of Aisha's bar by renaming the third as sixths, then simplify.
guide.zh: 两条模型图都以 1 米为同样大的整体，表示丝带长度。先把三分之一化成六分之几，求 Aisha 多出来的一段，再化成最简分数。

hints.en: Look at the piece between the two ribbon ends.
hints.zh: 看看两条丝带末端之间的那一段。

hints.en: Use sixths for both lengths: {1/3} = {2/6}.
hints.zh: 把两个长度都写成六分之几：{1/3} = {2/6}。

hints.en: Find {5/6} − {2/6}, then simplify the difference.
hints.zh: 计算 {5/6} − {2/6}，再把相差的量化成最简分数。

say.en: You treated Siti's third as 1 sixth. Look at her bar: {1/3} spans 2 sixths, so subtract 2 sixths.
say.zh: 你把 Siti 的三分之一当成了 1 个六分之一。看看她的条：{1/3} 占 2 个六分之一，要减去 2 个。

say.en: You found the right difference. Look at the 3 extra sixths: they make one half; write that simplest fraction.
say.zh: 你找到了相差的量。看看多出来的 3 个六分之一：合起来是二分之一，再写成最简分数。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the extra piece, rename Siti's third as sixths, then subtract and simplify.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看多出来的一段，把 Siti 的三分之一化成六分之几，再相减并化简。

reveal.en: Aisha has {5/6} m and Siti has {2/6} m. The difference is {3/6} m, or {1/2} m in simplest form.
reveal.zh: Aisha 有 {5/6} 米，Siti 有 {2/6} 米。相差 {3/6} 米，化成最简分数是 {1/2} 米。

prompt.en: Daniel drank {8/9} L; Arjun drank {2/3} L. How much more did Daniel drink?
prompt.zh: Daniel 喝了 {8/9} 升，Arjun 喝了 {2/3} 升。Daniel 多喝几升？

guide.en: Both bars use 1 litre as the same whole. Rename Arjun's amount as ninths, then find the extra piece of Daniel's bar.
guide.zh: 两条模型图都以 1 升为同样大的整体。把 Arjun 喝的量化成九分之几，再求 Daniel 多出来的一段。

hints.en: Look at the bracket between the two amounts.
hints.zh: 看看两个量之间的问号括号。

hints.en: Split each third into 3 equal parts: {2/3} = {6/9}.
hints.zh: 把每个三分之一平均分成 3 份：{2/3} = {6/9}。

hints.en: Find {8/9} − {6/9}. The difference is measured in litres.
hints.zh: 计算 {8/9} − {6/9}，相差的量以升为单位。

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} = {6/9}, so Daniel drank {8/9} − {6/9} = {2/9} L more.

say.en: You subtracted both numerators and denominators. Look at the unit cuts: rename the thirds as ninths, and keep ninths when subtracting.
say.zh: 你把分子、分母分别相减了。看看模型图的份：先把三分之几化成九分之几，相减时每份仍是九分之一。

say.en: You treated the 2 thirds as 2 ninths. Look at Arjun's bar: it covers 6 ninths, which you need to subtract.
say.zh: 你把 2 个三分之一当成了 2 个九分之一。看看 Arjun 的条：它占 6 个九分之一，要减去 6 个。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at Arjun's bar in ninths, then subtract its amount from Daniel's.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看看 Arjun 的条，把它写成九分之几，再从 Daniel 的量中减去。

reveal.en: Arjun drank {6/9} L. Daniel drank {8/9} L, so the extra piece is {8/9} − {6/9} = {2/9} L.
reveal.zh: Arjun 喝了 {6/9} 升，Daniel 喝了 {8/9} 升，所以多出来的一段是 {8/9} − {6/9} = {2/9} 升。

caption.en: Seven quarters: they fill one whole strip and 3 parts of a second one.
caption.zh: 7 个四分之一：填满一整条纸条，还多出第二条的 3 份。

caption.en: Each whole still has 4 parts, so the parts are quarters. 4 quarters make 1 whole and 3 quarters are left.
caption.zh: 每个整体还是 4 份，所以每份是四分之一。4 个四分之一是 1 个整体，还剩 3 个四分之一。

caption.en: On a line from 0 to 3 cut into thirds, {2 1/3} is 2 wholes and 1 more third.
caption.zh: 在从 0 到 3、每个整体平均分成 3 段的数轴上，{2 1/3} 是 2 个整体再加 1 个三分之一。

caption.en: {11/4}: two wholes take 8 quarters and 3 quarters are left over.
caption.zh: {11/4}：两个整体用了 8 个四分之一，还剩 3 个四分之一。

keyFacts.en: Each whole keeps the same number of parts.
keyFacts.zh: 每个整体的份数不变。

keyFacts.en: {7/4} = {1 3/4}: 4 quarters make 1 whole.

prompt.en: Shade 7 quarters. Then write it as a mixed number.
prompt.zh: 涂出 7 个四分之一，再写成带分数。

guide.en: Each strip is one whole cut into 4 quarters. 4 quarters fill the first strip and 3 more go on the second: 1 whole and 3 quarters.
guide.zh: 每一条是一个整体，平均分成 4 份。4 个四分之一涂满第一条，另外 3 个涂在第二条上：1 个整体和 3 个四分之一。

hints.en: Fill the first strip, then go on to the second.
hints.zh: 先涂满第一条，再接着涂第二条。

hints.en: 4 quarters make 1 whole.
hints.zh: 4 个四分之一是 1 个整体。

hints.en: 1 whole and {3/4}.

correct.en: Yes. 7 quarters = 1 whole and 3 quarters = {1 3/4}. As an improper fraction it is {7/4}.
correct.zh: 对。7 个四分之一 = 1 个整体和 3 个四分之一 = {1 3/4}。写成假分数是 {7/4}。

say.en: Each strip is one whole cut into 4. The bottom number stays 4, even with two strips.
say.zh: 每一条都是一个整体，平均分成 4 份。就算有两条，分母还是 4。

fallback.en: Not yet. Write how many whole strips are shaded, then the quarters on the next strip.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先写涂满了几整条，再写下一条涂了几个四分之一。

reveal.en: One strip full and 3 quarters of the next: {1 3/4}.
reveal.zh: 一整条加下一条的 3 个四分之一：{1 3/4}。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {2 1/3}.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在 {2 1/3}。

guide.en: Each whole from 0 to 1, 1 to 2 and 2 to 3 is cut into thirds. {2 1/3} is 2 wholes and one more third: one jump past 2.
guide.zh: 0 到 1、1 到 2、2 到 3，每个整体都平均分成三段。{2 1/3} 是 2 个整体再加一个三分之一：过了 2 再跳一段。

hints.en: Find 2 on the line first.
hints.zh: 先在数轴上找到 2。

hints.en: Make one jump of {1/3} after 2.
hints.zh: 从 2 再跳一段 {1/3}。

correct.en: Yes. {2 1/3} is one third past 2. As an improper fraction it is {7/3}.
correct.zh: 对。{2 1/3} 在 2 后面一个三分之一的地方。写成假分数是 {7/3}。

say.en: Count the jumps after 2, not the marks. {1/3} past 2 is one jump.
say.zh: 从 2 往后数段，不是数刻度线。比 2 多 {1/3} 就是再跳一段。

fallback.en: Not yet. Go to 2, then one jump more.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先到 2，再跳一段。

reveal.en: {2 1/3} is one jump past 2.

prompt.en: Write {11/4} as a mixed number.
prompt.zh: 把 {11/4} 写成带分数。

guide.en: 4 quarters make a whole. 11 quarters are 2 groups of 4, which is 8 quarters, and 3 more: 2 wholes and {3/4}.
guide.zh: 4 个四分之一是一个整体。11 个四分之一是 2 组 4 个（8 个），再多 3 个：2 个整体和 {3/4}。

hints.en: How many groups of 4 quarters are in 11 quarters?
hints.zh: 11 个四分之一里有几组 4 个？

hints.en: 2 groups of 4 is 8. How many quarters are left?
hints.zh: 2 组 4 个是 8 个。还剩几个四分之一？

correct.en: Yes. {11/4} = {2 3/4}: two whole strips and three quarters of the third.
correct.zh: 对。{11/4} = {2 3/4}：两整条，加第三条的四分之三。

say.en: The parts are still quarters, so the bottom number stays 4. After 2 wholes, 3 quarters are left over.
say.zh: 每份还是四分之一，所以分母还是 4。凑满 2 个整体后，剩下 3 个四分之一。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the whole strips first, then the quarters left over.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数有几个整条，再数剩下几个四分之一。

reveal.en: 8 quarters fill 2 strips and 3 quarters are left: {2 3/4}.
reveal.zh: 8 个四分之一涂满 2 条，剩下 3 个四分之一：{2 3/4}。

prompt.en: Shade 5 thirds. Then write the amount as a mixed number.
prompt.zh: 涂出 5 个三分之一，再写成带分数。

guide.en: Each ribbon is one whole cut into 3 equal parts. Fill one ribbon with 3 thirds, then shade 2 thirds of the next ribbon.
guide.zh: 每条丝带是一个整体，平均分成 3 份。先涂满一条的 3 份，再涂下一条的 2 份。

hints.en: Look at how many equal parts make one whole ribbon.
hints.zh: 看看一整条丝带有几份。

hints.en: 3 thirds make 1 whole; keep counting on the next ribbon.
hints.zh: 3 个三分之一是 1 个整体，再接着涂下一条。

hints.en: You need 1 whole ribbon and {2/3} of the next.
hints.zh: 你要涂 1 整条和下一条的 {2/3}。

correct.en: Yes. 3 thirds fill one ribbon and 2 thirds are left: {5/3} = {1 2/3}.
correct.zh: 对。3 个三分之一涂满一条，还剩 2 个三分之一：{5/3} = {1 2/3}。

say.en: You counted the parts in both ribbons as one whole. Look at one ribbon: it has 3 parts, so the bottom number stays 3.
say.zh: 你把两条丝带合起来当成一个整体了。看一条丝带：它有 3 份，所以分母还是 3。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count 5 shaded parts, then count the full ribbons and the thirds left over.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数涂了 5 份，再数涂满几整条、还剩几个三分之一。

reveal.en: Shade 3 parts on the first ribbon and 2 on the second: 1 whole and {2/3}, or {1 2/3}.
reveal.zh: 第一条涂 3 份，第二条涂 2 份：1 个整体和 {2/3}，写成 {1 2/3}。

prompt.en: Shade 5 halves. Then write the amount as a mixed number.
prompt.zh: 涂出 5 个二分之一，再写成带分数。

guide.en: Each strip is one whole cut into 2 equal parts. Fill two strips with 4 halves, then shade one half of the third strip.
guide.zh: 每条纸条是一个整体，平均分成 2 份。4 个二分之一涂满两条，再涂第三条的一半。

hints.en: Look at the two halves in each whole strip.
hints.zh: 看看每条纸条的两个二分之一。

hints.en: Group the 5 halves in pairs to fill whole strips.
hints.zh: 把 5 个二分之一每两个凑成一整条。

hints.en: 4 halves fill 2 strips; one half is left.
hints.zh: 4 个二分之一涂满 2 条，还剩一个二分之一。

correct.en: Yes. 5 halves are 2 whole strips and half of the third: {5/2} = {2 1/2}.
correct.zh: 对。5 个二分之一是 2 整条加第三条的一半：{5/2} = {2 1/2}。

say.en: The 6 parts belong to three separate wholes. Look at one strip: it has 2 parts, so the bottom number stays 2.
say.zh: 这 6 份属于三个整体。看一条纸条：它有 2 份，所以分母还是 2。

fallback.en: Not yet. Shade 5 halves, then count the full strips and the half left over.
fallback.zh: 还没对。涂出 5 个二分之一，再数涂满几整条、还剩多少。

reveal.en: Shade both halves of each of the first two strips and one half of the third: {2 1/2}.
reveal.zh: 前两条各涂满两份，第三条涂一份：{2 1/2}。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {1 2/5}.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在 {1 2/5}。

guide.en: Each whole on the line is cut into 5 equal intervals. Start at 1 and make two jumps of {1/5} to reach {1 2/5}.
guide.zh: 数轴上每个整体都平均分成 5 段。从 1 开始，再跳两段 {1/5} 就到 {1 2/5}。

hints.en: Find 1 and look at the intervals between 1 and 2.
hints.zh: 找到 1，看看 1 到 2 之间的分段。

hints.en: Count two intervals of {1/5} after 1.
hints.zh: 从 1 往后数两段 {1/5}。

hints.en: Use the second mark after 1.
hints.zh: 放在 1 后面的第二个刻度。

correct.en: Yes. {1 2/5} is two fifths past 1; each whole still has 5 intervals, so it is also {7/5}.
correct.zh: 对。{1 2/5} 在 1 后面两个五分之一的地方；每个整体还是 5 段，也写作 {7/5}。

say.en: You stopped after one jump from 1. Count the gaps between marks: you need two jumps of {1/5}.
say.zh: 你从 1 只跳了一段。数刻度之间的间隔：要跳两段 {1/5}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find 1, then count two equal intervals to the right.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找到 1，再向右数两段相等的间隔。

reveal.en: 5 fifths reach 1 and 2 more fifths reach {1 2/5}: the second mark after 1.
reveal.zh: 5 个五分之一到 1，再走 2 个五分之一到 {1 2/5}：1 后面的第二个刻度。

prompt.en: Put the marker at {2 5/6}.
prompt.zh: 把标记放在 {2 5/6}。

guide.en: Each whole on the line is cut into 6 equal intervals. Start at 2 and count five jumps of {1/6}; the parts stay sixths all along the line.
guide.zh: 数轴上每个整体都平均分成 6 段。从 2 开始，再跳五段 {1/6}；每一段始终是六分之一。

hints.en: Look at the part of the line between 2 and 3.
hints.zh: 看看数轴上 2 到 3 的这一段。

hints.en: Count five intervals after 2, keeping each jump at {1/6}.
hints.zh: 从 2 往后数五段，每次跳 {1/6}。

hints.en: Use the mark one interval before 3.
hints.zh: 放在 3 前面一段的刻度。

correct.en: Yes. Five sixths past 2 is {2 5/6}, one sixth before 3; it is also {17/6}.
correct.zh: 对。2 后面五个六分之一是 {2 5/6}，离 3 还差一个六分之一；也写作 {17/6}。

say.en: You made four jumps after 2. Count the intervals between marks; five jumps of {1/6} reach the next mark.
say.zh: 你从 2 跳了四段。数刻度之间的间隔；跳五段 {1/6} 才到下一个刻度。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start at 2 and count five of the six equal intervals towards 3.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 2 开始，向 3 数六段相等间隔中的五段。

reveal.en: 12 sixths reach 2 and 5 more reach {2 5/6}: the mark just before 3.
reveal.zh: 12 个六分之一到 2，再走 5 个到 {2 5/6}：紧挨着 3 前面的刻度。

prompt.en: Write {9/5} as a mixed number.
prompt.zh: 把 {9/5} 写成带分数。

guide.en: Each chocolate bar is one whole cut into 5 equal parts. Group 5 of the 9 fifths into one whole and count the fifths left over.
guide.zh: 每条巧克力是一个整体，平均分成 5 份。从 9 个五分之一中拿出 5 个凑成一个整体，再数剩下几个五分之一。

hints.en: Look at the full bar and the marked parts on the next bar.
hints.zh: 看看涂满的一整条和下一条涂出的部分。

hints.en: Take 5 fifths from 9 fifths to make one whole.
hints.zh: 从 9 个五分之一中拿出 5 个凑成一个整体。

hints.en: You have 1 whole and 4 fifths left.
hints.zh: 你有 1 个整体，还剩 4 个五分之一。

correct.en: Yes. 5 fifths make one whole and 4 fifths remain: {9/5} = {1 4/5}.
correct.zh: 对。5 个五分之一是一个整体，还剩 4 个五分之一：{9/5} = {1 4/5}。

say.en: You used the 10 parts across both bars for the bottom number. Look at one bar: it has 5 parts, so the remainder is {4/5}.
say.zh: 你把两条共 10 份写成了分母。看一条巧克力：它有 5 份，所以剩下的是 {4/5}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the full bars first, then the fifths left on the next bar.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先数有几整条，再数下一条剩下几个五分之一。

reveal.en: One whole uses 5 of the 9 fifths, leaving 4 fifths: {1 4/5}.
reveal.zh: 一个整体用了 9 个五分之一中的 5 个，剩下 4 个：{1 4/5}。

prompt.en: Write {9/4} as a mixed number.
prompt.zh: 把 {9/4} 写成带分数。

guide.en: Each strip is one whole cut into 4 equal parts. Make two groups of 4 from the 9 quarters, then count the quarters left over.
guide.zh: 每条纸条是一个整体，平均分成 4 份。把 9 个四分之一凑成两组 4 个，再数剩下几个四分之一。

hints.en: Look at the two full strips and the part marked on the third.
hints.zh: 看看涂满的两条和第三条涂出的部分。

hints.en: Two wholes use 8 quarters; subtract 8 from 9.
hints.zh: 两个整体用了 8 个四分之一；用 9 减去 8。

hints.en: You have 2 wholes and 1 quarter left.
hints.zh: 你有 2 个整体，还剩 1 个四分之一。

correct.en: Yes. 8 quarters fill two strips and 1 quarter remains: {9/4} = {2 1/4}.
correct.zh: 对。8 个四分之一涂满两条，还剩 1 个四分之一：{9/4} = {2 1/4}。

say.en: You used the 12 parts across three strips for the bottom number. Look at one strip: it has 4 parts, so the leftover part is {1/4}.
say.zh: 你把三条共 12 份写成了分母。看一条纸条：它有 4 份，所以剩下的那份是 {1/4}。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count groups of 4 for the wholes, then keep the leftover parts as quarters.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每 4 份凑成一个整体，剩下的每份仍是四分之一。

reveal.en: 9 quarters are 8 quarters and 1 more: 2 wholes and {1/4}, or {2 1/4}.
reveal.zh: 9 个四分之一是 8 个再加 1 个：2 个整体和 {1/4}，写成 {2 1/4}。

prompt.en: Write {1 5/6} as an improper fraction.
prompt.zh: 把 {1 5/6} 写成假分数。

guide.en: Each strip is one whole cut into 6 equal parts. Rename the whole as 6 sixths, then count the 5 extra sixths with them.
guide.zh: 每条纸条是一个整体，平均分成 6 份。把一个整体写成 6 个六分之一，再加上多出的 5 个六分之一。

hints.en: Look at the number of parts in one full strip.
hints.zh: 看看一整条纸条有几份。

hints.en: Count 6 sixths for the whole and 5 sixths on the next strip.
hints.zh: 一整条是 6 个六分之一，下一条还有 5 个六分之一。

hints.en: 6 + 5 = 11 parts, and each part is still {1/6}.

correct.en: Yes. One whole is 6 sixths, and 5 more make 11 sixths: {1 5/6} = {11/6}.
correct.zh: 对。一个整体是 6 个六分之一，再加 5 个是 11 个六分之一：{1 5/6} = {11/6}。

say.en: You counted the 12 parts in both strips as one whole. Look at one strip: it has 6 parts, so the bottom number stays 6.
say.zh: 你把两条的 12 份当成一个整体了。看一条纸条：它有 6 份，所以分母还是 6。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count all the marked sixths for the top number and the parts in one whole for the bottom.
fallback.zh: 还没对。分子数所有涂出的六分之一，分母数一个整体有几份。

reveal.en: 6 sixths in the full strip plus 5 sixths on the next make {11/6}.
reveal.zh: 一整条的 6 个六分之一，加下一条的 5 个六分之一，合起来是 {11/6}。

prompt.en: A plate of kaya toast is cut into 8 pieces. Shade {3/4} of it.
prompt.zh: 一盘咖椰吐司切成 8 块。涂出它的 {3/4}。

guide.en: The plate is one whole in 8 equal pieces. Each quarter of the plate is 2 of those pieces.
guide.zh: 这盘吐司是一个整体，平均分成 8 块。它的每个四分之一是其中 2 块。

hints.en: Each quarter of the plate is 2 of the 8 pieces.
hints.zh: 每个四分之一是 8 块中的 2 块。

correct.en: Yes. {3/4} = {6/8}: each quarter is 2 eighths, so 6 pieces.
correct.zh: 对。{3/4} = {6/8}：每个四分之一是 2 个八分之一，所以涂 6 块。

say.en: You shaded {3/8}. Each quarter is 2 eighths, so {3/4} is 6 pieces.
say.zh: 你涂的是 {3/8}。每个四分之一是 2 个八分之一，{3/4} 是 6 块。

fallback.en: Not quite. Each quarter of the plate is 2 of the 8 pieces.
fallback.zh: 差一点。每个四分之一是 8 块中的 2 块。

reveal.en: 6 of the 8 pieces: {6/8} = {3/4}.

prompt.en: Which fraction is equal to {2/3}?
prompt.zh: 哪个分数等于 {2/3}？

guide.en: Equal fractions multiply (or divide) the top and the bottom by the same number.
guide.zh: 等值分数是把分子和分母乘（或除以）同一个数。

hints.en: Multiply the top and the bottom of {2/3} by the same number.
hints.zh: 把 {2/3} 的分子和分母乘同一个数。

correct.en: Yes. {2/3} = {4/6}: the top and the bottom are both multiplied by 2.

say.en: {3/4} adds 1 to the top and the bottom. Equal fractions multiply both by the same number.
say.zh: {3/4} 是分子分母各加 1。等值分数要把分子和分母乘同一个数。

say.en: {2/6} changes only the bottom number. Cut every part the same way: the top and the bottom both change.
say.zh: {2/6} 只改了分母。每一份都要同样地分：分子和分母都要变。

fallback.en: Not quite. Look for the fraction whose top and bottom are both 2 times bigger.
fallback.zh: 差一点。找分子和分母都变成 2 倍的那个分数。

guide.en: Quarters and eighths are different sizes. Each quarter is 2 eighths, so {3/4} = {6/8}.
guide.zh: 四分之一和八分之一大小不同。每个四分之一是 2 个八分之一，所以 {3/4} = {6/8}。

hints.en: How many eighths make {3/4}?
hints.zh: {3/4} 是几个八分之一？

say.en: 5 is more than 3, but eighths are smaller than quarters. Rename {3/4} as {6/8} first.
say.zh: 5 比 3 大，但八分之一比四分之一小。先把 {3/4} 换成 {6/8}。

fallback.en: Not quite. Rename {3/4} in eighths, then compare.
fallback.zh: 差一点。先把 {3/4} 换成八分之几，再比。

prompt.en: Write {8/12} in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 把 {8/12} 化成最简分数。

guide.en: Divide the top and the bottom by the same number until only 1 divides both.
guide.zh: 分子和分母同时除以同一个数，直到只有 1 能同时整除它们。

hints.en: Which is the biggest number that divides both 8 and 12?
hints.zh: 能同时整除 8 和 12 的最大的数是几？

correct.en: Yes. {8/12} = {2/3}: both numbers divided by 4.

say.en: Equal, but not yet simplest: 4 and 6 can both be divided by 2.
say.zh: 是相等的，但还不是最简：4 和 6 都能被 2 整除。

say.en: Only one number was divided. Divide the top and the bottom by the same number.
say.zh: 只除了一个数。分子和分母要除以同一个数。

fallback.en: Not quite. Divide the top and the bottom by the same number.
fallback.zh: 差一点。分子和分母要除以同一个数。

reveal.en: Divide both by 4: {8/12} = {2/3}.

prompt.en: The line from 0 to 1 has 8 equal jumps. Put the marker at {3/4}.
prompt.zh: 0 到 1 平均分成 8 段。把标记放在 {3/4}。

guide.en: The jumps are eighths. Each quarter is 2 eighths, so {3/4} is 6 jumps from 0.
guide.zh: 每段是八分之一。每个四分之一是 2 个八分之一，所以 {3/4} 在离 0 六段的地方。

hints.en: How many eighths make {3/4}?
hints.zh: {3/4} 是几个八分之一？

correct.en: Yes. {3/4} = {6/8}: 6 jumps from 0.

say.en: That is {3/8}. The jumps are eighths, and {3/4} is 6 of them.
say.zh: 那是 {3/8}。每段是八分之一，{3/4} 是 6 段。

say.en: One jump off. Count the jumps from 0, not the marks: {3/4} is 6 jumps.
say.zh: 差了一段。从 0 数段，不数刻度线：{3/4} 是 6 段。

fallback.en: Not quite. Each quarter is 2 of the jumps.
fallback.zh: 差一点。每个四分之一是 2 段。

reveal.en: {3/4} = {6/8}, the end of the 6th jump.

prompt.en: Work out {5/6} − {1/3}. Give the answer in its simplest form.
prompt.zh: 计算 {5/6} − {1/3}，答案化成最简分数。

guide.en: Each third is 2 sixths, so {1/3} = {2/6}. Take away the sixths, then simplify.
guide.zh: 每个三分之一是 2 个六分之一，所以 {1/3} = {2/6}。先减六分之几，再化简。

say.en: The tops and the bottoms were taken away separately. Rename {1/3} as {2/6} first.
say.zh: 这是把分子、分母分别相减了。先把 {1/3} 换成 {2/6}。

say.en: Thirds are bigger than sixths: {1/3} is 2 sixths, not 1.
say.zh: 三分之一比六分之一大：{1/3} 是 2 个六分之一，不是 1 个。

say.en: {3/6} is right but not yet simplest: 3 and 6 can both be divided by 3.
say.zh: {3/6} 是对的，但还不是最简：3 和 6 都能被 3 整除。

fallback.en: Not quite. Rename {1/3} as sixths, take away, then simplify.
fallback.zh: 差一点。先把 {1/3} 换成六分之几，相减，再化简。

prompt.en: Aisha ate {1/6} of a pandan cake and her brother {5/12}. How much in all?
prompt.zh: Aisha 吃了斑兰蛋糕的 {1/6}，弟弟吃了 {5/12}。两人一共吃了几分之几？

guide.en: Each sixth is 2 twelfths, so {1/6} = {2/12}. Add the twelfths.
guide.zh: 每个六分之一是 2 个十二分之一，所以 {1/6} = {2/12}。再把十二分之几加起来。

say.en: Sixths and twelfths cannot be added top and bottom. Rename {1/6} as {2/12} first.
say.zh: 六分之几和十二分之几不能把分子、分母分别相加。先把 {1/6} 换成 {2/12}。

say.en: Sixths are bigger than twelfths: {1/6} is 2 twelfths, not 1.
say.zh: 六分之一比十二分之一大：{1/6} 是 2 个十二分之一，不是 1 个。

fallback.en: Not quite. Rename {1/6} in twelfths, then add.
fallback.zh: 差一点。先把 {1/6} 换成十二分之几，再相加。

text.en: No. The same whole cut into more parts gives smaller parts.
text.zh: 不对。同一个整体分得越多，每份越小。

text.en: Yes. 5 is more than 3, so {1/5} is greater.
They are equal: both are one part.
text.zh: 一样大：都是一份。

prompt.en: Wei Jie says {1/5} > {1/3} because 5 > 3. Choose a picture and a reason.
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 说 {1/5} > {1/3}，因为 5 > 3。选一幅图和一句理由。

guide.en: Compare fractions of the same whole only. Under one whole, a fifth is narrower than a third.
guide.zh: 只能在同一个整体下比较分数。在同一个整体下，五分之一比三分之一窄。

hints.en: Which picture shows two wholes of the same length?
hints.zh: 哪幅图里的两个整体一样长？

correct.en: Yes. With the same whole, {1/3} is wider than {1/5}. Wei Jie is not right.
correct.zh: 对。在同一个整体下，{1/3} 比 {1/5} 宽。Wei Jie 说得不对。

say.en: In picture B the two wholes are different lengths. We can only compare fractions of the same whole.
say.zh: 图 B 里两个整体长短不同。只能在同一个整体下比较分数。

say.en: More parts in the same whole means each part is smaller, so {1/5} is smaller than {1/3}.
say.zh: 同一个整体分的份数越多，每份越小，所以 {1/5} 比 {1/3} 小。

say.en: Both are one part, but the parts are different sizes: a third is bigger than a fifth.
say.zh: 都是一份，但每份大小不同：三分之一比五分之一大。

fallback.en: Not quite. Choose the picture with two wholes of the same length, and the reason that matches it.
fallback.zh: 差一点。选两个整体一样长的那幅图，再选和它相符的理由。

reveal.en: Picture A, and: the same whole cut into more parts gives smaller parts.
reveal.zh: 图 A，以及：同一个整体分得越多，每份越小。
